"7580363712658882570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"結上文横闌之意。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712658882570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340946932551991333"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水𦆵過穴而反跳，一文不值，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712658898954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水𦆵過穴反跳斜，流者一文不值安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足取㦲？","logicSentenceId":"7580363712658898954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水若八懐而反抱，一發便衰。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712658915338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水入懐而反抱向外者，绥初年發福，必易見衰敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"返跳水圗水口則愛其𦂳如葫蘆喉","logicSentenceId":"7580363712658931722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水口者，水流去處是也，欲其髙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而拱","logicSentenceId":"7580363712658931722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"抄而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"塞，及生異砂，盖有","logicSentenceId":"7580363712658931722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如。亀蛇如獅象，如龍虎，如印笏之類，関䦨緊宻，内寛石外狭，如葫蘆，喉之小，不見水之去。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者斯。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712658931722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水口之吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"抱身則貴其彎如牛角樣，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712658948106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水城只愛弯𤨔，抱身來去不拘左右。劉氏曰：來不𣣔冲，去不欲。直横不欲斜，其弯抱如牛角，如眠弓，如腰帶，此水城之吉。若斜返而去，或急响如雷，如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"箭射如䋲牽。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712658948106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此水城。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之","logicSentenceId":"7580363712658964490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340946441977774132"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凶也。楊公曰：只爱山來抱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身體","logicSentenceId":"7580363712658964490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不爱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水返","logicSentenceId":"7580363712658964490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"去從他。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交牙，截水者，最冝聳㧞","logicSentenceId":"7580363712658964490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"交牙者，水口两邉之山相乂䦨截，不使水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之去也。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712658964490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其交牙之山，最","logicSentenceId":"7580363712658980874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"冝。高葺峭㧞，屹然相對而峙。如列旗布陣，如挿㦸護垣，重重交銷節。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"捍禦内，𠰥大","logicSentenceId":"7580363712658980874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"将屯兵，外則無階，可進此水。口之至貴也。扵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内必結冨貴之地，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712658980874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若城門曠蕩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飛水走山。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712658980874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"又非吉矣。𦂵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然融結好地，亦主","logicSentenceId":"7580363712658997258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"發福不乆也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當面。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712658997258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"潴水者惟愛澄凝，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659013642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"潴水者言明堂，或池或潭，或江或湖，旣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然潴畜渊停，惟","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659013642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"愛澄清疑净。此亦塟經所謂朝扵大旺澤扵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"将衰。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659013642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聳拔者如紏紏武夫之捍城，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659030026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此承上又言水口山聳㧞如武夫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"捍禦城池，則守之固也。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659030026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"澄凝者，若肅肅賢臣之拱位，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659046410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"澄凝者，温柔不動之貌，欲其清㓗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"停積而静，如賢臣朝扵，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659046410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"帝位，則自然端嚴，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拱之之意專矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659046410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340946932552024101"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水口之砂，最𨶹利害，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659062794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水口者，龍神之門户，水城之鎻鑰。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"関則","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659062794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吉，開則凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"實有関扵","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659062794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"利害也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659062794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"特舉其大畧，當自察，其細微","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659079178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"搃結以章，水法不過大畧而巳，其細","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㣲當自求之。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659079178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右第五章論水法。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659095562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水固切於觀流","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659111946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上章言水之関係甚重，固切扵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀覧，宜𤨔抱曲，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659111946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"流有情為吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山尢難於認脉","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659111946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上文切觀水法之重，下文謂辨脉尢難。曽氏曰：𡬶龍之法，㸔其","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勢。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659111946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取穴之法，看其","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659128330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"脉。勢𩔰而有形則易見，脉𨼆而無形則難明。楊公有三十六","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脉。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659128330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陶公有十：","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659144714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二脉劉公有十四脉，脉訣至玅，故曰尢。難認之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或𨼆顯於茫茫逈野，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659144714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"以言逈野之脉，體叚不一，有平坡渺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"渺茫茫如鋪氊展席，而未者有田，埢","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659144714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"層級若水之波而耒者，有起峯墩如星珠亀魚而耒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者有㣲","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659144714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"露毛脊如浮漚鳬鳥而耒者，皆是地之吉氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340946441977806900"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"湧起，故土亦随之而凸也，其来也止。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左有","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659144714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"両也，邉有水右砂以选之，其以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衛之且","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659144714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"明堂寛正，又淂横水䦨之外。陽逺案在乎缥缈之間，四圍隂砂，僅髙𢾗寸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"而平，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659144714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"洋巳之貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此皆也。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659144714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"绖曰：地貴平夷，土貴有支，亦此意也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或潜藏於淼淼平湖，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659161098","marginNoteIdLi in":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君識相連相牽，尋","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659210250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"断绝盡是楊公真口訣，過村如雁列深雲。藏時猶似泥中鱉，平洋相並盞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中酥落，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659210250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"在平洋。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"誰辨","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659210250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"别又云坪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"中還有","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659210250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一流坡髙水，一寸却是阿。只為時師眼力淺，到此茫然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無，柰","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659210250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"何便云。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無處𡬶踪跡，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659210250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"直到有山。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方認淂不知山窮","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659210250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340946932552106021"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𠰥坪去，穴在坪中貴無敵。痴師悮了幾多人，又道埋藏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"畏卑，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659210250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"濕，不知穴中有水心如此難慿怕泉楽盖縁水張。在中問：水退則同乾地立，且如兩堆坪似掌，也有軍州落窠儮也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有英","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659210250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雄在。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其中，豈無墳墓與宫。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659210250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"室只将水注。與水流，兩水夾流。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是龍脊星散孤村秀氣全無半點，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659226634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言平洋之龍勇起平，實変五星之形也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其星","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659226634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"形飄散孤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"露無","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659226634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"情，以致靈氣不聚，全無半點融结之處。楊公曰：散子脉滿鄕村，如風送。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善亂紛","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659226634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天，正此意也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雲蒸，貴地精光略 arginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之照，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659226634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"應也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有諸内，必形諸外。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659226634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659243018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"云内氣萌生，外氣成形家寳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𦀇云：隂陽真氣者，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659243018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"逰扵土皮之下，又曰：氣藏土。内謂之内氣，水流土，外謂之外，氣，外者众。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"字三人之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659243018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分合有其内，則其形見扵","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659259402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"外，故内外相符。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659259402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲求真的，逺朝不如近朝，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659275786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"逺朝乃衆山。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"趍向之","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659275786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"朝近朝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃本","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659275786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"身持配。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之朝，故逺","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659275786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"朝雖然尖。秀不如。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"近朝方","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659275786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"員有情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况近朝。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659275786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福應之","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659292170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"速逺遅朝，蔡氏福應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：若要發之","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659292170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"福急𮟃是近朝山，如無近朝亦當逺。對仍審恃。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與，不特楊公","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659292170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"曰朝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山亦","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659292170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"自有真朝，恃來假若。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pin {"lines":[{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右第六章論龍脉行度：若見土牛隱伏水纒，便是山纒","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659652618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"結穴處，號曰土牛。𨼆伏者，穴之隈藏也。寅旣𨼆藏，又貴乎水轉山迎，纒遶為吉。氷鏡經云：落穴之中號土牛，更湏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"停蓄，是為優龍","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659652618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"回水轉山。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"城秀，子息當封萬户侯。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659652618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或如甌鳥浮沉，脉好自然好。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659669002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鷗，水鳥也，言脉之竹如鷗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鳥浮","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659685386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水一同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或浮，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659685386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"或沉而來，來則有送，止則有從，必結大局，故曰脉好自然穴好。陶朱公捉脉賦云：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遺踪失跡。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659685386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"湖𥚃鴈鵞，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712659701770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亦此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content" {"lines":[{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340946441977872436"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛛絲馬跡無龍神落泊以難明，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712930873371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蛛絲馬跡，皆言龍神落泊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平洋藏踪閃","logicSentenceId":"7580363712930873371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"跡，藕断絲連。惕公曰：抛梭馬跡線如絲，倁蛛過水上難，魚驚蛇入草。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"失行跡断","logicSentenceId":"7580363712930873371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"脉断跡𡬶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耒能。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712930873371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故","logicSentenceId":"7580363712930889755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"曰：難明，陶公损脉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"云馬","logicSentenceId":"7580363712930889755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"跡過水，揽衣度河，無形無影，豈類髙坡。凡遇此等脉法，湏要仔","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"細消詳，當以髙诋分","logicSentenceId":"7580363712930889755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寸之間而辨之可也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"彷彿髙低，依稀遶抱","logicSentenceId":"7580363712930889755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此結工文未定難明之意，言𡬶龍脉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者當招","logicSentenceId":"7580363712930889755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"髙低彷佛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"處辨其","logicSentenceId":"7580363712930889755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"髙一寸者。為龍，低一寸者為水，則脉可𡬶矣。叉扵遶抱處察其何。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者真為𤨔","logicSentenceId":"7580363712930889755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"遶，何者？直為拱抱，則穴可定矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求吾所大𣣔，無非逆水之龍，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712930889755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"逆水之龍為重，福應之速；順水之龍，福應之遅，故吾欲其𨒫也。塟書問荅有問者曰：萬事皆順，惟金丹與地理為𨒫者，何也？對曰：人有五識，外應五","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行流精布，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712930889755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"无以飬形。也，陽施隂受，以以傳代也。非逆不足以握神机而成造化。天五𪸓行乎地中，流潤湿生，草木荣也。絪緼上騰，發光著也，非逆不足以配靈爽，而貫米𡨋，知金丹地理之爲逆者，則生氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得所乗","logicSentenceId":"7580363712930889755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之机矣，夫豈一物𭔹時之名？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㦲。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712930889755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947178371858458"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逆水龍之圗，使我快扵心，必得入懐之案","logicSentenceId":"7580363712930906139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凢案山，欲其當靣特耒，如人拜者，或如龍之蟠屈鳯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之翔，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712930906139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"舞，或兩角抱身，如弓之弘，如几之平，此入懐之案也。若案山無情，雖尖員方正。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦無所補。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712930906139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故楊公","logicSentenceId":"7580363712930922523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"云：若是真朝。直入懐，不必尖員如龍馬，但要低昻起伏耒，不爱尖斜直去也，直去名為墜朝山。雖見","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尖貟","logicSentenceId":"7580363712930922523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也是閑，譬如貴人。對靣立，與我情意不相関。此言照山雖然尖員方正，苟無","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"情馬","logicSentenceId":"7580363712930922523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不如。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入懐之美也。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712930922523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"73409462 ,{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"提右仙宮之類。其单提仙宫之穴，本身雖然有左無右，有右無左，淂外枝山水耒應護者，斯爲義也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左右仙宮之圗。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712931643419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無龍要水遶左邉，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712931659803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無青龍，要水從左邉來，遶右抱穴而去則吉。劉氏曰：水来自左，無左亦可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無虎要水纒右畔。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712931659803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無虎，要水泛右来，遶左而去則吉。劉氏曰：水從右，耒，無右亦裁。指南云：有龍無。虎多為上，有虎無龍亦不凶。若淂处山耒接應，分明有穴福常豊。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右第八章論龍虎相山亦似相人","logicSentenceId":"7580363712931840027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"藝文志云：相地與相人並列。明山寳鑑云：人不入。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形，不相地，不入","logicSentenceId":"7580363712931840027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"形不塟，人有大小。長短賢愚貴賤之分，山有髙低肥瘦、斜正方員之異，人禀五星之正者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712931840027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之人山得五星之正者，結冨貴。之地，然或有相貌不足而富貴者，此竒怪状也，扵此猶宜詳之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947126727426057"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"點穴猶如點艾","logicSentenceId":"7580363712931856411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"楊公曰：大凡點穴非一様，降勢隨形合星象。譬如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"銅人針灸穴穴","logicSentenceId":"7580363712931856411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上究詳方始當忽。然針灸失其真，一指隔差連命䘮。誠哉斯言，穴法不可不謹也。夫髙一尺則傷龍，低一尺則傷穴深。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則氣泛","logicSentenceId":"7580363712931856411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上過浅則氣從下過，是故㸃穴之難，如針灸之不易也。愚嘗類編三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寳經。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712931856411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"穴法類詳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一毫千里，一指萬山。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712931872795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此承上文點穴之難，不可毫厘之差。古云：到頭差一指，如隔萬重山。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若有生成之龍，必有生成之穴。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712931889179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旣有真龍，必有真穴，自然之理也。吾","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祖嘗","logicSentenceId":"7580363712931905563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"云真龍必。不閑生未可以到頭𨼆拙而棄之。詩云：隂陽正訣要心通，諸家卦例不湏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"窮真龍自","logicSentenceId":"7580363712931905563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有天然穴，煩君仔細認真。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"踪，不拘单向䨇向，但㸔有情無情，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712931905563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龍穴旣正，立向尢要賓主有情。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羅經","logicSentenceId":"7580363712931905563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二十四向皆可。向，豈拘单向双向乎？双向者，如丁向加午，丙向加巳，坤向加","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未夘。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712931905563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","line eId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也全慿眼力，斟酌髙低，細用心梲。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932134939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𠫭詳向背","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932151323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此結上文，指掌脫龍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之法大","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932151323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947331224911922"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"横直之扞，或髙或低，在竭目力以斟酌之；或向或背，在竭心思以𠫭詳之。至扵横受橫落無龍，湏下有龍直送。直奔有氣，要安無氣。若此之類，惟在心目之巧以裁之，斯可矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内直外鈎，儘堪裁剪","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932151323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言内砂雖直而外陽，鈎轉関闌亦堪裁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剪楊公曰：内直外鈎","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932151323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此地難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"求，内鈎外直枉費心。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932151323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"梲","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932167707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言内砂雖抱而外陽，飛走無情，枉用心机。楊公曰：内曲外直少隆衣。","logicSentenceId":"0"," {"lines":[{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340946517974597672"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山本静，勢求動處","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932216859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山本是静物，貴乎一起一伏，踴躍而耒，此静中而求動。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932216859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水本動，妙在静中","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932233243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水本是動物，貴乎不流不響。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"澄凝。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932233243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而聚，此動中而求静也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"静者，池沼之停留，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932249627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水静是池塘深𤁎縮蓄之意。經云：𤀎扵蓄聚，此動中而求静也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"動者，龍脉之退䣃。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932249627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山動","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932266011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"是龍之踴躍翔舞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"起伏脫卸而耒","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932266011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"楊公曰：退卸愈多愈。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有力。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932266011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衆山止處是真穴，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932282395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"衆山相聚之𠁅，必有真穴，但","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"擇其星辰端","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932282395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"正異衆而取。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932282395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衆水聚䖏是明堂，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932298779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"衆水聚處是明堂，又有内外之别。内明堂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水聚","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932298779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"發福速外。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明堂水","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932298779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雖聚發福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遅。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932298779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堂中最喜聚窩，","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932315163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"明堂喜有窩窟，使水之聚也。洞林秘訣云：明堂如掌心，家富斗量金。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴後湏防仰瓦","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932315163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"仰瓦者，穴後有塢槽也。此空亡龍不結地。訣曰：問君何者是空亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴後捲","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932315163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"空仰九勢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更看前官後鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932315163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"問君何者謂之官，朝山背後逆拖山。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問君何者謂之鬼","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932331547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主山背後撑者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932331547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947331224977458"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仰瓦孝順鬼圗，方知結實。","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932331547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虚花","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932347931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"要知穴之真偽，必先辨其官鬼。有官鬼，真穴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無官","logicSentenceId":"7580363712932347931","margi ineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生人，福也。一穴不正，舉皆偏斜，不淂其氣，𥚽也。楊公曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當急而緩，富貴而取，當緩","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711482378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而急瘟大必生，此𥚽福之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驗。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711482378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有異穴怪形，我之所取，人之所棄，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711498762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"或真龍迢○而來，到頭𨼆拙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多結靈","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711498762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"異之。穴竒怪之形。楊公曰：也曽見穴如側掌，却與仰掌無两様也。鲁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見穴真，如鎗两","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711498762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水射。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脇，實難當也。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711498762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有龍","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711515146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"虎两頭。尖，左牙右劔休要嫌，也有龍虎生口嘴，時師到此何鲁喜。也有左長右枝短，也有左短","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右枝長也。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711515146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有主山","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711531530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"所牛。軛也有前案似拖鎗，世俗庸師多不取，那知異穴生賢良若此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，識者取之，不識者棄之。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711531530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見藏牙縮瓜，機不可測，妙不可言，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711547914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凢龍之未住，則分牙布瓜，龍之将","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至則縮","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711547914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"瓜藏牙尖利者変爲圎齊，飛動者変為安静。此乃真龍蟠泊，其机巳露，惟智者知之，而常人不可則。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"度。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711547914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711564298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"妙無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340946441977970740"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"窮，惟識者逹之，而難以言語形容也。陶公曰：悠○而縮瓜藏形，𨼆○而無頭無緒，豈知","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇水為真，乘風則散。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711564298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竒形圣穴之圗，石骨過江河，無形無影","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711580682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"石骨過水，潜藏難辨，况又穿江渡，可無形影可求。若不觀其両岸形，勢，烏能知之。訣云：漏脉無時看不得，留心仔細看龍格。穿山渡水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過，真從","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711580682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1320","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"認他石骨為真脉，亦此意也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平地起培搂，一東一西","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711580682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"培楼者，平中之小阜也。或東或西，大小不等，而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無定","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711580682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"拘經曰：地有吉。氣土随而𧺫支有止，氣水随而比此言平。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地，吉氣","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711580682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"勇𧺫，故土亦随之而突。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711580682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947507150700582"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當如沙裏揀，金","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711597066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此承上文過江之脉，無形無影，平地之脉𨼆○","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隆當如沙裏淘，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711597066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金，則真僞自分矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定要水來界脉。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711597066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此承上文㣲𨼆之脉，非水分則莫知其行，非水界則莫知其止。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊公曰：髙","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711613450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"土一寸，則是山低土一寸水回𤨔莫道㣲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"茫龍氣弱，水來纒遶","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711613450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"足堪安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平洋穴湏斟酌，不冝掘地及泉，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711613450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"南方平洋之地，土薄宜淺，掘𣵫則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有泉水之患。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711613450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"其法當以合水處斟酌之。合水處立一標，準穴上立一標，隼以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

Id":"7580363818711908362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1474","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"折不瀦，直流無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"情鍳","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711908362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1476","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水。極変經云：凡墓宅前，必湏三折千神水干者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙、丙丁、庚辛","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711908362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1478","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"壬癸，乾坤艮巽是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711908362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圗上觀形，隨機應變，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711924746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1481","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山川形状，変化不一，紙上圗形，發蒙而巳，全在人随机而変也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴太髙而易發，花先發而早凋","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711924746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1483","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"九、黠穴太髙截，生氣之盛，故發福如花之速綻而早。凋也。穴緩發福雖遅而耐乆。穴法云：定穴太髙君大錯。花若先開，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"早落，低穴勢中","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711924746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1485","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"發福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遅祻福。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711924746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1487","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之，未無尅剥。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1488","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340946221567361059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髙低得宜，福祥立見。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711941130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此承上文㸃穴，當髙則髙，當低則低，𠰥左","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右髙低","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711957514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"淂宜，則福祥立應。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711957514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖曰山好則脉好，豈知形真則穴真，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711973898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1495","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雖云山㸹，逹則脉盡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善豈知","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711973898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1497","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"形端正則穴。情真坤輿云：問君為地必有形，不知形自何由成？隂陽融結為山。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水品物流形，随","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711973898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1499","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寓生","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在地有","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711973898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1501","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"形天有𧰼，凡有形者，因氣疑。凢氣疑結，有五九之星体，人物、禽獸之等，形各有穴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法其","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711973898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1503","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"萬状千形，皆由星之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"変化，故形真。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711973898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1505","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"則穴。自然真也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"枕龍鼻者，恐傷於唇，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711990282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1507","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龍首扵鼻顙中之吉，唇皮浅薄凶。故唇鼻相近，㸃穴太緩，則脱氣傷唇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㸃龜肩者，恐傷於殻，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711990282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1509","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龟肩則厚納吉，殻則浮露凶，但肩殻相接，急則恐傷脉，故扞肩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則吉","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711990282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1511","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如忠壮程公祖墓盛多𣼛羅靈亀出洞形。肩穴得氣遇異人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"題白石","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711990282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1513","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"為記，指曰塟此，𠰥題後公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生有","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711990282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1515","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"功扵國，殁，謚曰世。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忠","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711990282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1517","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947389479469065"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍鼻、龜肩之圗。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818711990282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出草蛇以耳聼蛤，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712006666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1520","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蛇形有三寸穴，七寸穴王字頭上穴如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"聴蛤蛇形則仟耳","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712006666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1522","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上穴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要邉有蛤，則其","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712006666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1524","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"情氣攻扵耳，乃深曲藏風之所，故吉。又有上山蛇形，冝扞糞門穴，但觀山水，有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"情處為穴可也。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712006666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出峽龜以眼顧兒，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712023050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1527","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龜形湏上水為貴。育尾並吉，頭眼未可扞。今言顧見情意聚扵眼，故扞眼穴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舉一隅而反二隅，觸一類而長萬，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712023050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1529","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"然形穴之多，扦形萬类状，難以俻述，但舉一隅，則三隅可知。觸類而長，以盡其餘全。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在人","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712023050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1531","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"心目之明，不可執一而論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712023050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1533","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947112911192104"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然穴吉猶忌塟凶，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712039434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1535","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雖淂吉地，而術者不淂其法，或差髙低深浅之間，是謂之塟凶也。指南云：立穴若還裁不正，縦饒吉地也徒然，高低深浅如差悮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"変福為","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712039434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1537","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"灾𧺫祻愆。又云：塟凶者，其病不一，有不信隂陽。而妄白仠塟者，有輕親重利而不求其吉地者，有不積隂功而山靈変異者，有謬用庸術而不知正穴者。故地吉塟凶徃○有之。為今之計，先以積德爲本用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財，擇明師付之。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712039434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三者𠔥俻，吉穴得烏。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712055818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右第九章論塟㳒，立向辨方，的以子午針爲正。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712072202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1541","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"昔軒轅、黄帝與","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蚩尢","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712088586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1543","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"戰蚩尢能作大霧，黄帝制指南針，以示方也。至周南交趾國，越裳氏來朝，忽迷歸路，周公作。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午針","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712088586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"置之扵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"車名曰指","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712088586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"南車自漢張子房只用十二。支。至唐以耒取十千，除戈巳居中，只用八干𣸸，乾坤艮巽，分作二十四。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"位以","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712088586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1549","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天地四方中。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分之，自後有正縫","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712088586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之。説吾郡董徳彰採諸論，取壬子、丙午縫針爲是，稽理未","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712088586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712104970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不復論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"愚意謂正針者，子午","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712104970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯酉居四，正乾坤、艮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1557","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947574213361714"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1558","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巽居四維，子為正北，壬發輔之，午為正南，丙丁輔之，夘為正東，甲乙輔。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之酉，為","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712104970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1560","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"正西庚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午輔之。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712104970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况謝覺","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712121354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1563","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"齋云子午為隂陽之正極，夘酉爲天地之横樞，以子午為天地之中南比之正。本文謂立向辨方的以子午針爲正，即正，針也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作當依法，湏求年月日之良","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712121354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1565","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"安墳立宅，必擇年月日時之良利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712121354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"范氏","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712137738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1568","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"曰：好地如巨舟。良時如利楫巨舟能載物，利楫能行舟，䕃主者風水之吉也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發作者，年","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712137738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1570","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"月之良也。楊公曰：不知年月，有玄㣲年。月奥妙少人知。年月乃爲造命法，装成好命恣人為。若人生時","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淂好，命一生，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712137738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1572","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"享福𠔥富盛，不獨巳身富貴髙。十世雲仍故官定考之楊公當時頭用通天竅，利物濟民，誠為尅擇之主，扵是暇日以通天竅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"義瞭然明","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712137738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1574","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"矣。而又以宅婚塋三元輻輳成書，名曰三元。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"集成同志君子，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712137738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1576","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寺監","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山川有小節之疵，不减真龍之厚福。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712137738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1578","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"疵，小病也。凡龍身特。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"達踴","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712154122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1580","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"躍而耒到頭。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712154122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1582","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340946870690136099"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712154122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1584","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有小節之疵病，終不為之大害也。一辰端正，四顧有情，特其中或一砂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"年月有一端之失，反爲吉地之深殃。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712154122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1586","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雖得吉地，而犯年月之凶，必","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主生","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712170506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1588","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"灾。禍楊公云：地吉塟凶禍先發，名曰棄屍福不耒，此是先賢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"景純","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712170506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1590","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"説，景純湏説無年月。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後耒","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712170506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1592","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"年月故，十家一。半自頭無尾結，大抵此文無十全，大半都是俗師傳統例一百二十家。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九十四家月與年，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712170506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1594","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"問之，一一真通。道：飛布星辰説玄奥，試令㨂懌作宅墳，福未到時禍先到，誠㦲！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斯言則","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712170506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1596","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"楊公年月之妙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有廖金精年月可","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712170506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1598","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𠔥用之，餘家年月無準而未可用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712170506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"多是信異說而昧正言","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712186890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1601","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"正言者，良師非正經不言，非正法，不用異説。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712186890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗師装","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712203274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1604","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦例邪。道尅應之説也。詭筭小数，妄言禍福，及鬼靈經之","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"類，皆是惑世誣，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712203274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1606","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"民切。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不可信用也。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712203274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以生新凶而消已福，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712219658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1609","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"有一等庸師詭術，昧乎徃哲之正言，私生怪異之邪。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"説無主見","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712219658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1611","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947507150766118"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1612","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之家，反信之如神，致其扇惑，悉聴命焉。使之扦宅，則生者不得安其居；使之作塜，則死者不得安其塟。使之選擇，則不得年月之良，舊福旣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"消新。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712219658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1614","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凶又作良。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"可惜也。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712236042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不然，山吉水吉而穴吉，何以多灾？","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712252426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1617","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旣得山水之吉，必䕃之以福，何故多？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"灾豈知年凶月凶而日凶，犯之㒺覺","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712268810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1619","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上文言山水旣吉何。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為生","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712268810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1621","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"灾，盖由選擇貂。凶以致然也。愚𠹉考尅擇之凶者，山向忌年月日時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅山正，隂府","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712268810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1623","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"太嵗浮天，空亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天官符，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712268810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1625","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巡山羅侯羅天大退等星，造以黄道為主，忌火瘟、受死等星，塟以鳴吠為主，怨犯重䘮、入地、空亾之類，諸吉星不能制之，立見灾個。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過則勿憚攺，當求明師，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712268810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1627","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"主之信異説，術之昧正言，皆過也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過則當攺","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712268810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1629","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"必求明師，𤀎言地可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712268810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"擇焉而不精，悮於管見，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712285194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1632","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"師要懌主徳，主要識師賢。□之術者，惟執巳見尅擇，不以楊公。年月為主。察地不以郭氏塟𦀇為宗，反以偽書相","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惑此","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712285194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1634","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"擇烏不精矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如管，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712285194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1636","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"窺天。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所見極小。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712285194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712301578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1639","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"悮尢多。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1640","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"conten
