{"lines":[{"lineId":"1646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"擬富貴於茫○指掌之間，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712317962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1647","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"言，庸師管見，學識未。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明擬妄","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712317962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1649","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"富貴出扵掌訣之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"間，認禍福於局○星辰之内言祠福出扵圖局之上，謂局○畨卦例論星辰扵方位也。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712317962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈知大富大貴而大者受用，大富大","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712334346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1652","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貴由山川之氣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大聚，故徳","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712334346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1654","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之大。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者而","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712334346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1656","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大受用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712334346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小吉小福，而小者宜當。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712350730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712367114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1660","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吉小福由。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山川，德","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712367114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1662","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之氣小聚，故之小者而","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宜當","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712367114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1664","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"也，墳宅一沐。而推。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712367114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人家個福富貴大小","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712383498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1667","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"砂水䕃在龍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之穴，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712383498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1669","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"注豈扵掌訣圗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"局之","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712383498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1671","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"間乎。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偶中其言，自神其術，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712383498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1673","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此結上文，言庸師装圗局而凶畨論掌訣，吉以断𥚽福，一言偶中夸。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"術如神殊","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712383498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1675","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不知堪輿，云善断墳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，下穴必謬，扵則穴塟","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712383498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1677","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"必敗以下。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以断墳穴，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712383498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1679","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"断墳則断不騐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"理固然矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712383498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟一朝之財賄，當如後患何。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712399882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1682","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"苟，且也。此言術者不以隂功為重，苟。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圗眼","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712416266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1684","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"下之財利。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1685","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947389479501833"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1686","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳妨人，則彼此並受其禍。吾祖𠹉日卜筮不精，繫扵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事医藥不精，害扵","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712416266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1688","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人，地里不精，傾家滅族，深可戒哉！","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謬千里於毫厘。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712416266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"請事斯語矣，","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712432650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1691","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此結本章地里尅擇之法。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"差之","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712432650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1693","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"毫厘失之，千里術不。可不謹也。或察地不能辨其偽，或選擇不能□其凶，差扵","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"毫厘","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712432650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1695","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"之間，則𥚽福擬扵影響之應，同志君子可不謹。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㦲。","logicSentenceId":"7580363818712432650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"追尋仙跡，看格尤勝看書。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512000531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"仙跡者，乃前年地仙所作之遺跡也。後學者雖知書訣，務要登山覆實舊仙跡是何龍穴，作如何取舎，思過半矣。揚公云：勸君且去覆好墳，勝讀千卷撼龍文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奉勸世人，信耳不如信眼。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512016915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言世人但以所聞之地為主，不以所見之地為信，盖為目力不明，雷同扵人，而况耳所聞者未必真，目所見者，斯可𢴃此信耳，所以不如信眼也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山峻石粗流水急，豈有真龍。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512033299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山𡽗峻石粗惡水傾瀉，此乃極凶之地，豈有真龍耶？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左廻右抱主賓迎，定生賢佐。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512049683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龍虎回抱，賓主相迎，斯為吉地，必産賢良，以佐明主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947574213427250"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取象者必湏形合。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512066067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"取象呼形，必湏相合，然後為真。形合者，如将軍形要旗鼓屯兵為案；金釵形要簾幕粧䑓為案，魚龍龜鱉近水為竒。千形萬状，觸物而推，必象與形合，斯可矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入眼者定是有情。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512082451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"入眼者，謂其形勢秀麗，四顧周遮，入人之眼如此，定是山永有情矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但有冨貴之祖墳，必得山川之正氣。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512098835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"覆富貴家之地，必淂龍穴之真，山川之正。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何年興，何年廢，鑑彼成規。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512115219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"凡龍脉之來，節歎不等，或竒或拙，以致興廢不常。若以步山之法驗之，則何年興瘠，皆可知矣。然節有長短，應有逺近，故凡若貴若賤，若福若禍，一以前賢舊塜鑑之，必響應。而不謬矣。故經云：景純教人。覆舊穴，此説昭匕能破昏。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"某山吉，某山凶，瞭然在目。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512131603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"某山尖秀主貴，某山方員主富；某山粗惡以斜，主出軍賊迯亡之類，或出扵子午卯酉之上主子午，卯酉主人。應之，禍福亦當其年，明目者瞭然，扵目中矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947507150864422"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pejvld0b/1-1710335722524.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=qdSqF9GpxfYNYyyoMzbxzjqmi0U%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pejvld0b/1-1710335722524.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580379539512147987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之，桐福立見，山之應驗稍遅。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512147987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山水永年净物，禍福應之，應之稍必遲速。此水並則結日夜上流動。吉文言人凶家冨貴祸福，皆由山地川吉，雖凶而吉而應之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地难吉而塟多凶，終無一發。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512164371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龍脉雖吉而塟不淂正穴，或而脱扦破天罡氣，或有破而敗傷龍，或番開扦合水之患，立向深淺之非。是皆塟凶永無，發福之理。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴尚隱而尋未見留得後人。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512180755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天之生人，地之生穴，苟非其人，則穴将隠而不顕，淂復失。雖淂吉地，或不遇明師，而不至識致其以穴扵，皆斯福分。若有神之，未物護持，致穴潜隱，留待後人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"右第十一章論仙跡祖墳","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512197139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母執已見，而擬精微。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512213523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"精改之理，至難知也，必余詳衆見以擬精微，不可偏扵一已之見也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"湏看後龍而分貴賤。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512229907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"富貴貧賤，皆係乎来龍。观龍之貴賤，則知吉穴之重輕。龍身木星火星帯","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947389479550985"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"印劔而来比，係貴龍，必結貴地；龍身土星、金星帯倉庫而来，必結富地。急硬孤死，此是賤龍不結地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三吉鍾於何地，則取前進後退之歩量。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512246291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三吉，貪、巨、武也。前進自穴而步水，后退自穴而歩龍，量山自穴中起一步，退一步，看龍節数，以定吉凶。遇三吉星，此代必發。量水自穴中起，一步退。一步定水之吉凶如步。数上遇深潭停清之处，此数年。財狂則吉；如遇飛走急瀉，此数年必凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼害出於何方，則取三合四衝之年應。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512262675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"董氏曰：刼害者，言堂局中必有凶山凶水，其説有数端：一者、天門不可山髙水射；二者、凹風射穴；三者、直斜之水，冲割明堂；四者、山脚尖利冲射。其凶山凶水，要諸在何方，定其災禍。三合者，寅、午戊、巳酉丑、亥、邜未、申子辰；四衝者，子午、夘酉、寅申巳亥、辰戌丑未，此地支三合、四冲也。天千三合者，乾甲、丁、坤乙、寅、巺、庚、癸、艮、丙申。四冲者，甲庚、丙壬、乙辛、丁癸，乾坤艮、巺。如午上有凶山凶水，則主寅午戎亥、子午邜酉，生人應之，灾禍亦當其年。如其方有吉山吉水，發福亦然。吉凶列","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947389479600137"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而推之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇吉則發，逢凶則災。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512279059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此結上文遇吉山吉水，必主發福；遇凶山凶水，必見生災山。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大水小者，要堂局之寛平。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512295443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山谷之地，山大水小不相稱，湏要堂局寬平，不見水小也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水大山小者，貴祖宗之髙厚。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512311827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"平洋之地，水大山小不相當，貴乎祖宗山髙大以稱之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"右第十二章論後龍","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512328211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一起一伏斷了斷，到頭定有奇蹤。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512344595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"陶公云：山谷則一起一伏，平地則而復續，相牽匕相愽而復断断。起伏相仍者，乃愽換星辰而来到頭。必結竒異之大地，故曰：定有竒隧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九曲九彎囘復囘。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512360979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下手便尋水口。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512377363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"靣前水如之玄九折，去而復囬，是曰洋匕悠匕，顧我欲留，有眷恋之情也。更要水口山重發，上交福乆逺鎖楊則主公云：更湏水口大山関，此地足堪安。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947507150897190"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山外山稠叠，補缺嶂空。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512393747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"稠叠，多也。若穴之四顧，或有凹缺，得外山稠宻，補嶂空缺，自然吉矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水外水横闌兮貟弩滿。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512410131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"随龍水之外，又得溪澗水，横過関闌，如弓之弯抱，主發福乆逺。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𦂳拱者富不旋踵，","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512426515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旋，轉也。踵，足眼也。董氏曰：左右財禄之山拱抱，主發福極速，未轉足發福遂遅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寛平者福必悠深。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512442899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"朝案寛舒，堂局平正，四山圍遶，並無空缺，只見衆水洋匕来朝，期堂局之善也，必結大地主，發福悠乆也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"修竹茂林，可驗盛衰之氣象。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512459283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"宅墳之傍，茂林䕃庇，則昌盛之兆；竹木衰朽，主人財衰敗之兆。大地以石為骨，土為肉，水為血，木為毛髪，骨肉盛，則龍氣旺而毛髪茂。覲外而知内，則吉凶可以預騐矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天關地軸，可驗富貴之速遲。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512475667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天関，即天門也。水来之處，有竒山異石；地軸即地户也；水去之所，有員墩、沙洲、石印也。近而見者，發福沦速；逺而不見者，發福必遅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947753050062886"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"右第十三章論水口","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512492051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牛畏直繩。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512508435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"土牛者，穴也，不宜水路，如繩直牽上，則土住牛不，主少亾退敗之兆。水鏡經云：牛住闌中，切忌牽匕他角，止退庄田。牽着鼻裏官事起，牽他眼耳。法塲前。楊公云：土牛不住惧人貧，是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎防暗箭。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512524819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"右臂為虎，不冝尖射，如暗箭之状。駐馬揺鞭去，虎卧牛眠。年月朝天，後宫無箭，鼻孔無穿。詩曰：虎怕後宫生暗箭，牛驚鼻孔被人穿。八明馬山揺鞭看，尋龍方顕遇神仙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"䋲箭之圖。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512541203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武不冝吐舌。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512557587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"穴前餘氣抽長，謂之玄武吐舌。穴法云：玄武嘴長髙處㸃，冝工力以裁之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947389479682057"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀切忌破頭。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512573971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"前山切忌崩洪破砕、響槽坑等状，必主生官突橫𥚽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吐舌破頭之圖。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512590355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴前忌見深坑。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512606739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"穴前有深坑，名曰隂泉，是無餘氣也。煙霞賦云：坑深岸窄，多因卒死早亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臂上怕行交路。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512623123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龍虎臂上忌行交路，名曰交刀，又謂之繩索，主有殺傷、自縊、紐鎻之患也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交路之圖。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512639507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947574213460018"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上不正而下參差者無用。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512655891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上欹斜不正，則脉不来；下長短不齊，則脉散亂，名倒掛棕櫚也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左空缺而右重抱者，徒勞。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512672275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"左右環抱，使氣之聚也，方成吉地。今既左邉空缺而右邉重抱者，必不結地，徒劳神耳。縱有穴，亦主旁分不正，右空缺而左重抱者亦然。若隔水有出護者，亦為吉矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倒掛棕櫚圖。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512688659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外貌不足而内相有餘，誰能辨此？","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512705043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"外貌砂水也，内相龍穴也。如龍真穴正，無可疑猜，而砂水有小可不足之䖏，亦可裁長補短而用之。或局外觀之，砂水無情，登穴一覧，情意有餘，扵此尤當辨之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大象可觀而小節可略，智者能知。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512721427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大象龍穴，砂水也，小節四者之餘也。若龍穴分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947753050095654"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"明砂水擁從，縱餘氣有纎毫不足處，則亦変凶為吉也。大勢有情，不可拘扵小節，故曰小節可畧耳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何精神顯露者反不祥。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512737811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"謂龍脉發見，左右相迎，人皆所喜，何反不祥？義見下文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"何形勢隱拙者反為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512754195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此言龍脉隠藏，形勢醜陋，人皆所棄，何反為竒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢隱拙者，却有竒踪異跡；","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512770579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此承上文言隠藏者，雖龍脉潜藏，形勢醜陋，而得左右護衞，前後朝迎，堂局完聚，此等脉穴財拙，乃是内君子而外小人也。去是竒妙之穴，常人豈能知之也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若顯露者，多是花穴假形。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512786963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此又承上文𩔰露者，雖龍脉出穴，左右包藏，多是虎結花假之穴。經云：君如識穴不識怪，只爱左右包者强。此與俗人無以異，多是塟在虗花𠂻。虚花左右似有情，子細辨來非正形。虗花假穴更是巧，子細觀占無甚好。怪形異穴人厭㸔，子孫如何世襲官。只恐怪形人未識，匕淂怪形却無難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947744590135323"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"膠柱鼓瑟者何知。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512803347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此承上文言𩔰露與隠拙之類，惟明哲変通者知之，被膠扵見聞，泥扵形局者，何足以知之？膠柱鼓瑟之鴈，足膠粘其柱，使之不動，豈能鼓瑟而淂聲音和也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"按圗索驥者何曉？","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512819731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"按圗索雲者，不求驥之徳，惟求馬之似，與装局求地何異㢤？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"城上星峰卓匕，真如揷戟護垣；","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512836115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卓上，高聳貌。言羅城星峯高聳，如兵列戟而護营也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靣前壠阜累匕，喚作排衙唱喏。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512852499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"累匕，相連貌。言堂局之前，低山貟以堆壠累七相連，如覆釡覆鍾之状，若𨽾卒誹衙，軍兵唱喏，此富貴之故，之如之也。舊夲作古塜累北，疑未然也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"華表捍門居水口。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512868883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一峯獨聳，謂之華表，両山並聳，謂之捍門。有此二星鎮水口，必結大貴之地也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楼臺鼓角列羅城。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512885267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"簇上高而員者，楼臺山也；簇上尖而秀者，鼓角山也。列扵羅城，見成大地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若非立郡遷都，定主爲官近帝。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512901651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此承上文山川大聚，局勢寛舒，可建洪都大郡，小則","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947753050128422"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巨鎮名材，且如歙之郡，基水口，聳華表，捍門羅城，列楼臺鼓角。衆山翕集，六水朝宗，則官清民安，世出近侍之貴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衆山輻輳者，富而且貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512918035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"輻輳，相聚會也。衆山皆拱揖，屯聚有情，冨貴双全之地。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"百川同歸者，清而又長。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512934419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"百川言衆山翕而衆水聚，則生氣大旺，主享福無疆。如金陵之地，山拱水朝，龍蟠虎踞，垣局寛舒，羅衆之輻輳；大江纒遶，聚百川之同歸，故王國祚悠逺也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山稱水，水稱山，不冝偏勝。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512950803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山水相稱，則為全美之地，偏勝不相稱也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎讓龍，龍讓虎，只要比和。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512967187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龍虎貴乎相譲而不相閗也。若弯環䧏伏，是曰比和。楊公曰：饒龍譲虎君臣足，下了令人增福禄。堂心資財上湧泉，積谷堆金無𢾗自。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八門缺，八風吹，朱門餓莩。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512983571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"八門四缺，八風交吹。經云：騰漏之穴，敗墩之藏也，主出餓莩。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947753050161190"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四水歸四獸聚，白屋公卿。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539512999955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四水歸聚扵堂，四獸朝迎乎局，又得護衞有情，雖非宦家，頃出公卿。楊公云：時人不識回龍脉，能令白屋出公。卿。故回龍脉多迎四山四水，富貴見之尤速。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"突中之窟雖扦。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513016339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"穴法云：髙山突兀，其中有窟。大凢髙山結穴處，坦然有窩，名曰包陽包隂，乃生氣隠藏之所。一窟甚微，萬象呈祥，乃至羙之所，可以扦之。朱仙𣑯曰：来不来，垣中裁，住不住，平中取。是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山水𤨔𮞚羅城周宻圖","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513032723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947574213525554"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"窟中之突莫棄。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513049107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"穴法云：平地有突，氣湧而生，絶勝萬仞，仙眼難明。平洋中有突，乃靈氣所鍾，最為竒玅。金木二星，行龍起突，名曰落地，𣑯花𣏭實，上有穴金。土，起突，作寳盖遺珠，却有刃鍾。有吐水滚浪金吐，水金。單獨一突，其氣聚扵巔，宜下盖穴。滚浪金連續不斷，其凸如區泡，如奔花，如串珠，如星斗而来，大則特小。小則持。大凢遇此等龍穴得其真，當出魁元、神童學士，此極貴之地也。議龍精賦云：七星入穴，定出釣衡，且如休邑。程尚書祖地士名水橋下乃串珠𣏭花龍，七星入穴，故䕃父子齊𩔰名也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"突浮圖","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513065491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"窮源千仭，不如平地一堆。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513081875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山水初發處曰窮源，入尺曰仭，此重言上下平地之羙被窮源。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947574213558322"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"絕谷雖秀。山千仞，緫不如平洋一堆之貴也。龍經云髙山。大壟尖峯多，不如平地一堆卓，亦此意也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外聳千重，不若眠弓一案。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513098259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"外峯高聳重匕，不如案抱暇弓。謂案弯環遮却朝迎山脚，自然羙也。况逺朝乃衆家所同，近案乃我之所獨，故言不如也。休邑程滚毅公敕塟南山外，朝雖逺，乃眠兮一案為竒也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平地凸眠弓案之圖。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513114643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山秀水響者，終爲絶穴。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513131027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山雖秀䴡，水流冲射，湍急而響者，終乆出絶也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947574213591090"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水急山粗者，多是神壇。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513147411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山形粗悪，分擘不常，水勢急響，直流不回。及有𡽡岩之悪山、恠異之悪石，此是靈異之所，不冝扦墳立宅，只作神壇社廟而已。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不論平地髙山，總宜深穴。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513163795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"髙山取窟，五氣沉，深則可也，平地取突，而氣浮，豈宜深乎？庸師不明生氣浮沉之理，多以此文為拘。深掘金井，至扵泉樂，則棺屍泥水汚害，使亡者不得安其膚，生者烏能受其福？吾嘗見犯者戒曰：平也深藏，則氣從上過。或對曰：雪心賦云：不論平地髙山，挽冝深穴。殊不知卜先生作以文，欲人以棺椁深藏，則兩水木根不可及，盜賊䖝蟻不能侵，在無後患，故發此語。至扵平地深者，謂如客士成墳，亦與深藏何異？前文有曰：平洋穴宜斟酌，不宜掘地及泉。觀此，則卜先生之心可見矣。故曰：不以文害辞，不以辞害意是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是窮源僻塢，豈有真龍。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513180179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"窮源僻塢，龍神不住，必無地矣。雖有小可，亦不乆長。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947574213623858"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逺着脚頭，髙擡眼力。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513196563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此結上文，言尋龍㸃穴，不可苟且而巳，必湏逺着脚頭，以目力以察觀其精微，其来三囬四髙，顧厯子竭，聞有隔細尋之，可山而也。未知者倘或知之，則説術非正道也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"右第十四章論髙山平地羅城","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513212947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"根大則枝盛，源深則流長。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513229331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"祖山髙大，則分枝之龍必盛矣；源水緜逺，則分𣲖之流必長矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要龍真而穴正。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513245715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"若有特達之真龍，必有分合之真穴者，求要龍之地，真穴之正，庶無花假之悮也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要水秀以砂明。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513262099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"砂水二者，皆要形容清秀，体態明净，扵我有情為貴.","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"登山見一水之斜流，退官失職。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513278483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"尖城水斜流，登穴見者，官主失我，庶人因官事而敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入穴見衆山之背去，失井𩀌鄕。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513294867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山頭句水，謂之𩀌郷砂，左邉去者，主長房𩀌郷；右邉去者，小房𩀌鄕。楊公云：一水去，二水去，衆水奔流一齊去。山山随水不回頭，失井𩀌郷無收助。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947744590168091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山飛水走之圗。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513311251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見文筆孤单，硯池汚濁。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513327635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孤峯欹削，左右不徔，故謂孤单。池塘斜返，固濁不清，名曰汚濁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"枉鑿匡衡之壁。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513344019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"漢匡衡，家貧無油，隣家有獨光，衡鑿壁孔引光讀書。後官至宰相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"徒關孫敬之門。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513360403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"楚孫敬，常閉户讀書，十年不出，睡則以繩繋頭足，懸扵梁上。𡮢入市，人號曰：閉户先生来也。此承上文。文筆雖秀而孤，池塘有水而濁，雖有孫敬、匡衡之篤學，終不能成効也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財山被流水之返牽，花蜂醸蜜。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513376787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"左右砂員伏者，謂之財山。其状不一，或如琴，或如秤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947753050226726"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如銀帶如輪，錢瓜瓠覆。盆之類𣣔其。拱抱為吉。若波流水返牽向。外去者，如蜂之釀蜜，為人取去，自不淂食也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"懐抱有圎峰之秀，異蜾蠃負螟。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513393171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"蜾蠃，土蜂也。其形似蜂，其色青翠。螟蛉柔樹上青䖝也。蜾蠃負桑，樹上青䖝也。負䖝教誨日曰曰：變七類，我為巳子。凢龍虎抱匕，一小員山在内，主有過房之子之應也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤峯斜圖","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513409555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947744590233627"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一嵗九遷，定是水流九曲。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513425939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一嵗九遷官，面前九曲水来朝護也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十年不調，盖因山不十全。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513442323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"十年三考滿不埀調，也因砂水不全。坤鑑云：擁從如無名位卑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水若屈曲有情，不合星辰亦吉；","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513458707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"星辰者，卦例謂貪、臣、禄、文、𤎉、武破、輔弼。又云：長生、沐浴、冠帶臨官、帝旺、衰、病、死、墓、絶、胎飬。又云隂山隂水，及御街六秀、黄泉八杀等類不一。而是。時師多以此等妄言凶吉，謂某方山水来合某星辰，某方山水去合某卦例，合其去則用，不合則棄之，因此刻舟求劔，是以吉地猶有存鳥。且如黄山宗人祖地，土名曹溪，宋謝玘氏過異人，并辰山戍向、戍水當面朝堂下後人財驟發，富貴双全，出通判我者六。觀此，則不合星辰亦吉也，信矣，何兄望合扵星辰耶？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山若欹斜破碎，縦合卦例，何爲？","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513475091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卦例多端，難以枚舉。或云艮丙、巽辛、兊丁為六秀方吉，辰戍丑未四墓方凶。且如本里胡氏祖城，土名黠川，係戎龍倒頭四墓上，頃起四金相對，折辰戍丑未四句。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947744590266395"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四向下後，人財两旺。本邑鄭師山先生所作此例。楊公云：山形有隼，卦例無馮然也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"覆宗絶嗣，多因水盡山窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513491475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"源頭水尾，龍氣不止，故不結地，又且水惡，塟之多主出絕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滅族亡家，總是山飛水走。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513507859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"山水飛走，滅族傾家。煙霞賦云：水走沙飛，定主離郷外死。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不問何方，允為凶兆。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513524243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此總結上文論星辰方位而言。但見山水𣣱斜飛走，不問在於何方，並為凶敗之地。楊公云：山水不問吉凶方，吉在凶方亦當強。暗流斜側山尖射，雖居吉位也衰亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"右第十五章論砂水不拘方位","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513540627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論官品之高下，以龍法而推求。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513557011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"明山寳鑑云：龍有七十二骨節，故祖宗山有大小，勢有髙低，一起為骨，一伏爲節，年有七十二候而成嵗，山有七十二節而成龍。如不及其数者，則所應大小之不同，亦不可拘於数也。凢有五六十節者，皆極貴之龍。如三四十節者，極品至三公之貴也；如五七節至十節者。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947744590315547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"七品至九品之貴也。萬物推龍能變化，故山以龍而喻之，龍長則力重，龍短則力輕，大祗龍貴砂貴，合成大局，則官品必髙。若只中局，貴亦如之，若結小局，不過財而巳。議龍髓賦云：論官品之大小，推龍法之精微，又要相山勢之髙低，垣局之大小，堂氣之聚散，地土之厚薄。且如閩蜀之地多尖秀，淮制之地多平夷，尢當理勢而推，不可一途而取。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙太乙侵雲外，位居臺諌。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513573395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天乙太乙木火之星，髙聲挿雲，宵者，主出内臺諫諍之官。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禽星獸星居水口，身處翰林。","logicSentenceId":"7580379539513589779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"問君如何謂之禽？龟魚生在水中心，或石或山，如龟魚，如秤斗，如覆几、鍾釜之類，名曰禽星。問君如何謂之獸？獸在諸山，如領袖，或山或石，如龍虎、如犀象，如馬牛之類，名曰獸星。此二星鎮扵水口者，主出翰林之言。禽獸詩云：有犀牛，有龍鳯，生在穴前真有用。忽然水口揖明堂，附鳯攀龍声價重。穴不真，君莫爱，若星不真反生害。此談分明不悮賢，千金莫易與人傳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947744590364699"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙太乙禽獸之圗。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948350015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"数峯挿天外，積世公卿。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948366399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天外逺也。數峯矗上，高聳雲霄，主出公卿之貴也。陶公云：筆挿雲端，管取天生豪傑。若後龍峯峦秀㧞，又淂前砂應之，則貴必騐之矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九曲入明堂，當朝宰相。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948382783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"九曲水入明堂，當出宰相之貴，九曲水去，亦吉。楊公曰：四橫三直過。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947744590397467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"東西九曲鳯凰池。若龍身不貴，穴法不真，縱群峯之挿漢，九曲之朝堂，則貴亦不驗矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九曲山水之圖。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948399167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左旗右鼓，武将兵權。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948415551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"旗鼓屯兵，主出元帥，旗兵多出武将，旗鼓全出文臣，亦有用之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前嶂後屏，父臣宰輔。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948431935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"前有帳幙掛榜山作朝，後有屏風𢓦座山護托，必主宰輔之聀也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947925175910426"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屏帳旗皷之圖","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948448319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"犀牛望月，青山出自天衢。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948464703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"犀牛望月，則月乃金星，清秀低小，多出神童及第。天衢，御街也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丹鳯啣書，紫詔頒於帝闕。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948481087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"形如丹鳯啣書，主子孫貴𩔰，受紫詔黄麻之聘。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文筆聮於誥軸，一舉登科。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948497471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"文筆峯與誥軸山相連，主出文章秀士及第。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"席帽近於御屏。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948513855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東宫夺讀。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948530239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"席帽山與御屏山相近，主出侍讀之官也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947925175943194"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"犀牛丹鳯之圖。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948546623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衙刀交劒，名持帥閫之兵。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948563007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"一沙尖抱，謂之衙刀；兩砂相抱，謂之交劔。龍身両邉埀下者，名曰龍身佩劒，主出征討大將軍議。龍精髓賦云：側如飛劔，非御史則出。提刑前沙見之亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皷角梅花，身領知州之職。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948579391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"皷角𣏭花山五峯連聳，惟中獨高，當出刺史知川之戒。坤鑑云。䅹𡎲三五，中心起監司并刺史","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"銀瓶盞注：富比石崇。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948595775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"小山累累，如盞瓶之様，主大富。石崇，西晋惠帝時人，有金谷園，富之極也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947744590430235"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉帶金魚，貴如裴度。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948612159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"水星弯抱，謂之玉帶；金星小巧，謂之金魚。龍身帯來者，主出大貴。裴度，唐憲宗時人，為宰相，有清節之風，文帝封晋國公，貴之極也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"皷角","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948628543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三千粉黛，牽公子之魂消。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948644927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"粉黛烟花，宫娥彩女也。喻之極貴之地，前後侍徔之多也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八百烟花，惹王孫之腸㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948661311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"群峯矗上，迎秀于前，叠嶂曽匕，侍徔于后，主出公侯。楊公云：来龍勢逺，似聖鸾輿，三千粉黛，八百烟花。詩曰：来龍勢逺㸔朝迎，似聖鵉輿擁陣行。左右𥪡旗連引劔，屯軍走馬。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947925175975962"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"列重城。宮娥玉輦楼臺起，排符旌節勢分明。三千粉黛當墳照，八百烟花對面生。劔佩簾前呼萬嵗，黄金殿上作公卿。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"娥眉山現，女作宫妃。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948677695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"娥眉山如初生月，乃太隂金星也，主女人清秀，為貴妃之貴。議龍精髓賦云：勢似娥眉，太隂縦出貴，亦主多生女。龍經云：平洋娥眉却為吉，平嶺娥眉最淂力。若有此星連節生，女作宫娥后妃聀。男家因婦淂官班，又淂資財并女色。若欹斜破碎，反主滛慾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金誥花開，男婚公主。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948694079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金誥山是土星，如横几，兩頭頗高，近淂娥眉金星相配是也。其金星主女，有花容月貌之羙，故借意謂之花開，必主男為附馬。舊註：花開是草木茂盛，若果如是，則栽培使之然也，宜詳之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魚袋若居兊位，卿相可期；","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948710463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"金星在西方，名曰金魚袋，主出風憲卿相之貴也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天馬若在南方，公侯必至。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948726847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天馬山髙聳，南方當岀公侯之貴，兩馬交馳亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947925176025114"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"頓筆多生文士。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948743231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"顿筆山是木星高聳，主出豪傑文人。煙霞賦云：𣣔求官我，湏尋卓筆之峯。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卓旗定出将軍。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948759615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卓旗山是火星，頭高脚擺，主出武聀。坤與云：装旗合旗、鳯翅旗，威武鎮邉夷。如越國汪公祖墓，王名登源洞，旗鎗矗上，兵甲巍上，而公生以神武，保障六州，納土歸唐，封忠武將軍，公殁謚廟曰世顕。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"筆旗圗","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948775999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内臺外閫，文武不同。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948792383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"内閣，文臣也；外閫，武将也。尖峯秀鹿，而有印誥、金榜、席帽，文筆書臺、王屏御座，此文臣之氣象也。戈甲兠鍪屯兵劔戟、旗鎗，此武将之氣象也。誅龍精髓賦云：臺星下有箭袋，先武後文。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947753050292262"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"將星下有文昌，先文後武。黒囊經云：文官龍頓起楼臺鳯閣，文官穴華盖三台，正落文官砂，旗鼓貴人簾幕，文官水左右来去，不折武官龍火星木星，武官穴紅旗出身，武官砂劔戟朝迎，武官水長流火城。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"某郡某州，分野可㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948808767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"論官我任扵何地，看貴峯出扵何方，以九州分野断之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二宮分野之地。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948825151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"齊、越、燕、宋、鄭、楚、周、秦、魏、趙、魯、衛。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"漢書謂二十八宿各諸侯分野，以治地方，譬如秀峰。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948857919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出扵已酉丑方，正巳酉丑生之。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948874303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人有貴，治荆趙、越之地天下亦倣例而推之。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948890687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947753050325030"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"御座御屏入内臺而掌翰。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948907071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龍身有御座、御屏，主内臺之聀及翰林之官也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"䪺鎗䪺鼓鎮外閫以持權。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948923455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"龍身有戈鎗旗鼓，聳拔而来，主鎮外閫，掌兵摧之聀也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶倉帯庫，陶猗之富可期，","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948939839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"黒囊經云：富有倉有庫。言龍身帶倉庫而来。及其止處，在右又得倉庫。沙護泛主巨冨。范蠡為越大夫，佐勾践破吳，不利。後乘舟入海，変姓名為陶朱公，積財萬億。齊人徛䪺聞其富，求見，請敎致冨之術。陶曰：畜五悖，猗泛其言，不十年，遂致大冨。越王思蠡，以金鑄其象。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948212523483162"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生曜生官，王謝之名可望。","logicSentenceId":"7580380258948972607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"問君如何謂之曜？餘氣生在兩肘后，龍虎外有餘氣飛揚，謂之曜氛。問君如何謂之官？案山背后拖山朝案，后山拖女舞袖拜龍之勢，謂之官星。官曜詩曰：龍虎通山尖且利，此是龍身鍾秀氣。穴前左右𧵑身生，喚作王侯官品地。或如鎗刀或如劔，随水順流飛冉匕。時師只断主離卿，豈知内有真龍占。又曰：官星不照，難求貴𩔰之名；曜宿立臨，定秉鈞衡之任。楊公云：非真龍正穴，必無官曜二星。官曜星其理不十，陽則為曜，以其見也；隂則為官，以其不見也。隠𩔰之異耳。秀氣所鍾，造化融結，而後有此。其福最厚，其状最異。或如錐如劔，鎗如刀、如鑚、如筆。或類失刀相刺，或如旗脚飛揚，有若戟士發矢，有如兵將交鋒，有頭有身，有脚有尾，有生有死，有去有来，有時照，有傍照，其形不一也。若得官曜二星同照，主出大貴，如王、謝之清名也。王道少有風鑑，佐晉元帝中興，號為仲父謝安高臥東山不出。晋穆帝聞其賢，徴之，拜為相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物以類推，穴以形取。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713732575295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫物各有類，類各有聚，如雲徔龍，風從虎，各以其類而推之。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713732591679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形者，五星之形體也。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713732608063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九㸃穴，必先認五星之形勢而後取也。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713732624447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如金星扦水窩穴，水星扦曲他穴，木欠二星三停穴、剪火穴，土星心角穴，其穴法有十二穴、三十六穴，七十二穴，其形有人物形、禽獸形。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713732640831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖形、穴二者，千変萬化，並不離乎五星之形穴也。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713732657215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如水、火二星多結人形，穴取臍心隂；金星多結禽形，穴取翼窩、冠尾；土星多結獸形，水星多結龍蛇形，其穴雖以鼻顙、耳腹頭尾名之，大抵要有脉止聚之處為穴，又要認皮頭鉗乳，方無悮也。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713732673599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊公云：来龍峰穴自天然，何必將禽與獸看。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713732689983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但認皮頭鉗乳穴，何曽形上岀髙官。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713732706367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎形耒勢直急，身雄頭小，橫土結其身，圎金結其頭。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713732739135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"獅形耒勢屈曲，身小頭大。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713732755519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金水結其身，䢍土結其","logicSentenceId":"7580351713732771903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pejvlpnf/1-1709709305758.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=wiweVRLKeZmC%2B6an6N%2FXCUy5xSA%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pejvlpnf/1-1709709305758.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580351713732771903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713732771903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其形雖相似，而","logicSentenceId":"7580351713732788287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947319543627839"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鴈與鳯凰不殊。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713732788287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鴈頭尾短鳯頭長，大抵禽形是金星，多，主貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713732804671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948212523565082"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或取斜曲爲釵，四圍不抱；釵形多是假，全慿包褁方真穴宜點脊不然氣冷難行。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713732902975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或求横直爲","logicSentenceId":"7580351713732919359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pejvm2aj/1-1709710027643.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=BibNrI2PoKbioAzuJnLVMh74lFA%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pejvm2aj/1-1709710027643.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580351713732919359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兩畔不包劔形是倒地木星，無弯曲之勢，要龍虎包褁，方可扦之，不然，則必如死鳝，不結地矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713732919359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文筆𥁞筆，二者何分，尖峯秀䴡端立者，謂之文筆；尖峯欹斜者，為𥁞筆也。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713732935743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衙刀殺刀，兩般無異。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713732952127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尖利弯抱者為衙刀；尖利直硬者為殺刀。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713732968511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若坐山秀䴡，殺刀化作，衙刀，來龍特逹，主山秀拔，而傍從有殺刀，亦化衙刀也。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713732984895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947319543693375"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或本主賤微文筆。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713733001279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"變爲書筆。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713733017663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"来龍欹弱，主山賤微，雖有文筆，亦變爲書筆也。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713733034047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尖鎗本凶，且遇武士以爲竒。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713733050431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前砂如尖鎗，乃凶殺之器。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713733066815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浮屍遇武士，固不祥，群反逄為有鴉用，為而吉也，反吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713733083199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倒屍山出人路死，不祥之文兆，遇群鴉形，反成吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7580351713733099583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"捲簾水現，入舎填房；穴前水一步低，一歩，傾瀉而去，謂之捲簾水，主人離財散，男子少亡，多生女子及寡婦，招他姓之人入舎填房也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697524265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"揚公云：田地被人來進舎，水犯捲簾也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697540649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"珥筆山尖，教唆詞訟，珥筆山如俏鑷一同，一峯聳起高大，一峯低小欹斜，主出人好興詞訟。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697557033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倒筆山亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697573417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂法云：前砂尖射投軍也，雙筆交尖到訟庭。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697589801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隠水迢匕筆直去，離着家鄕作逺行。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697606185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兒孫忤逆；面前八字水流，穴前有八字水分，主子係忤逆，墳宅皆然。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697622569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖得龍穴之吉，橫案□開","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697638953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pejy1urt/1-1709712078547.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=OVu%2BNm1AOmUkjaNhCP%2BwHv9NrWU%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pejy1urt/1-1709712078547.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580352944697638953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發福，亦不免出人不義及寡婦。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697638953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"董氏謂倒騎龍要両邉水去，在龍後與大水相同去則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697655337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"峽中結地，必犯八字水，但平遶則吉，傾瀉則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697671721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男女滛奔；案外抱頭山現抱頭山如山頭相抱，主男女滛","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697688105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pejy27ex/1-1709712159528.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=y4E23Bmd6qVngbfVBtAYJBAfOuo%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pejy27ex/1-1709712159528.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580352944697688105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如伸手抱員毬，婦女受風流。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697688105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉印形如破碎，非瞽目則王傷胎。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697704489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或山或石如印而破碎者，主瞽目傷胎之患也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697720873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金箱頭若髙低，非烟包則爲灰袋。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697737257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小巧方正，為金箱山。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697753641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若一頭髙而嵳峩，一頭低而","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697770025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pejy2k21/1-1709712505837.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=dDFCyxFy2bs8VT3goIe7l%2F6tlRQ%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pejy2k21/1-1709712505837.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580352944697770025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"側者，則為𤇆包灰袋山。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697770025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𤇆包山則主傷人，灰袋山主傷六畜。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697786409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若主秀，則又不騐。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697802793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"探頭側面，代有穿窬。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697819177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山外有山","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697835561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pejy2wp5/1-1709712571832.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Q4M7lqzE4dVZaBlEgZGlKM2aUl4%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pejy2wp5/1-1709712571832.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580352944697835561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"露者，謂之探頭山；側露者名側面山。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697835561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此二山出人為盗賊。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697851945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拭淚搥胸，家遭䘮𥚽左右有山，回為肘臂，近而迫穴，謂之拭淚山，或對胸髙起，謂之搥胸山。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697868329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697884713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947319543758911"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"起搥胸哭兒孫。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697884713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍虎兩拳頭，枉死淚双流。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697901097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腫脚出墳，","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697950249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pejy39c9/1-1709712895443.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=kfeB6vsvIlkVaFutrT3FF9s%2Fphc%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pejy39c9/1-1709712895443.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580352944697950249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瘟㾮浮腫。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697950249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山如冬瓜肥膀者，名曰腫脚。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697966633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山主出人浮氣黄腫，又主瘟。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697983017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947925176205338"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出林。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944697999401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"虎無以啖之，則傷人；此言出林虎其勢雄猛，唯恐傷人，要堆肉羅網案，以制其凶。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698015785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"且如予謝氏祖為予中舎衍公墓，土名塘朗虎形，郷人祭社，元扵彼處宰牲，俗謂食虎以求安，今社人以為例，此盖山川之靈也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698032169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若来龍卸却，杀氣入首，形勢降伏而藏牙縮爪者，則無凶矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698048553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伏草蛇無以制之則損已。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698064937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凢蛇形要䑕蛤、蜈蚣為案以制之，如無，亦主傷人。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698081321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若龍身不帯杀，亦無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698097705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍經云：太山峽里有鼠蛇，恐是高山脚漏斜。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698114089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是真蛇有鼠蛤，如無鼠蛤是虗龍。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698130473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蜈蚣鉗裏，眠犬懐中，懐中乳上穴，但其惡類，湏仔細扦之。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698146857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡此𢙣形，扦之有法，已上形勢凶𢙣，當以法度制之。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698163241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一説：蜈蚣形用酉年月時，犬形用寅年月日時以制之。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698179625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一說寅命人亦能制之。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698196009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵龍無杀氣，不凶昻者吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698212393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嘶馬必聞風扵他處，馬嘶風，則奔馳不止。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698228777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"董氏曰：他處者，應之逺也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698245161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948108672581695"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"□蛇還畏物扵坡中。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698261545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"驚蛇恐遭物擊，故穠隱扵坡中。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698277929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"物之没泥，蛇亦可取也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698294313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"取舟楫扵前灘，船形宜近水方爲真要風帆繩䌫還繞為案則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698310697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴逰魚扵上水。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698327081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"困魚龍脉最為鲜，如鰍如難綺溪邉。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698343465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"江潭湖浦皆由此，尾尖頭大帶𢇁牽。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698359849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"困魚偏要吞生水，觧透龍門直上天。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698376233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魚上水形，得水朝上，或近溪河，甚吉矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698392617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荷葉不堪重載，荷葉形力輕氣浮穴，不宜多塟，多塟則傷其力矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698409001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948212523696154"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瓜藤僅可小裁。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698425385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"瓜藤形氣脉亦小，不冝大開羅堂，僅可小裁而已。","logicSentenceId":"7580352944698441769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
