{"lines":[{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不可一途而取，豈容一例而言。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995934748735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此結上文穴法之意。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995934765119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言山川形勢，千変萬同，錐化以移步，人不物禽獸等形而名之。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995934781503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其穴法務要看生氣聚。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995934797887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"處爲之，不可拘扵形象，一途而取也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995934814271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葢粘倚撞，細認穴情夫盖者，氣聚扵山之巔，即天穴也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995934830655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟木、土、金三星冝下盖穴，水、火二星不可下之盖穴有三，曰華盖、雲盖、寳盖，其秘法至玄，難以。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995934847039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盡舉。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995934863423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫粘者，氣脉雄盛，氣降山之麓，朝山低軟，當粘則","logicSentenceId":"7580352995934879807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948212523761690"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"粘，則九星中地穴也，惟水、火、金三星宜下粘穴，水土二星不可下之。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995934879807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"粘穴有二：曰虗粘、實粘、虚粘，至難扦之。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995934896191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如龍降不急，認脉不真，反成泥水穴主絶。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995934912575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫倚者，偏而不正，氣聚其傍，即龍耳穴也，惟金、水二星有倚穴，木火亦有之。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995934928959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土星不可下之，左邉有情則倚其左，右邉有情則倚其右。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995934945343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"竒名有二：曰實倚、虗倚，要識避死揆生。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995934961727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至寳經云：主殺沖中奪塟其傍是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995934978111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫撞者，氣不在下，亦不在，上天生自然。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995934994495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"氣聚中正之處，即人穴也，五星皆可下之。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935010879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然撞有輕有重，朝山髙則以重為是，朝山低則以輕為竒。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935027263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巳上四穴，並要細認脉情緩急，朝山髙低而証之，方無悞也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935043647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖粘倚。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935060031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"撞之","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935076415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947096515887158"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吞吐浮沉，務依塟法。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935076415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫脉有隂陽，故穴有吞吐。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935092799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浮陽脉沉到塟也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935109183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡口内純隂二分，毬直簷下放如棺，謂劔脊，要之饒吐，此因隂其及氣縮下方借生。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935125567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡隂脉陽到，氣一","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935141951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pejy50jt/1-1709721611779.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=OfMaUiSvgVZbRl3AlPevOxXunuc%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pejy50jt/1-1709721611779.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580352995935141951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"噓，口内純陽，來如仰掌，要凑入毬生。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935141951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所以陽来則隂受，隂来則陽作，此求謂生氣之是跳寶出死氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935158335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家以經云：隂者為強，脉來雄急，泛上生下者，乃天氣下降，生氣露而不隠；沉謂之浮細，陽從者下爲生，弱，上脉來者，乃地氣上騰，生氣隠。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935174719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鄭氏塟而不曰得其露，謂法之沉則爲生氣；一失其道，謂滅則加饒借吞吐為死氣。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935191103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正此浮沉之類，並當依法而剪裁之，不致有撞。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935207487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺冲刑破揌畨開之患，唇臍目尾顙腹，三吉三凶，唇、目尾三凶，脐顙、腹三吉，角、耳、腰、足、鼻、脇四凶，二吉，耳鼻二吉，角、足、腰脇四凶。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935223871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此以龍為喻，但鼻顙中正而脐中曲，耳則深腹藏，故則定吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935240255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"唇脇淺薄，角目尾偏斜，又孤露，不受穴，故凶。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935256639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊証以方位。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935273023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"定之方也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935289407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948154461765669"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形似亂衣，妻必滛女必妬；山如衣裳亂雜者，主婦女滛亂。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935305791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：形如亂衣，妬女滛妻。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935322175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勢如流水家必敗人必亾。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935338559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靣前山勢飛走如流水，直去，並無回顧之情，主家財破敗，人了死","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935354943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pejy5d6x/1-1709721885905.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=JVjSodh%2BQcV%2FaS2rlZMBE30uaZg%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pejy5d6x/1-1709721885905.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580352995935354943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：勢如流水，生人皆鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935354943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其地切不可塟，塟之立見凶禍。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935371327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或遇提蘿之山，定生乞丐；左右朝山，如提蘿一般，或欹斜，主出乞丐之人。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935387711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見擎拳之勢，定出兇徒。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935404095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍虎山頭高起如擎拳之状，搥胸随穴者，主出兇狼之徒，悪砂之圖。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935420479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948108672663615"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水破太隂。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935436863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雲雨巫山之軰，太隂者，娥眉金星也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935453247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若水流来破金星成坑者，必主出女人，有巫山雲雨之情。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935469631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"董氏謂水流坤宫，是水破太隂，非也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935486015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坤輿云：啇音角音","logicSentenceId":"7580352995935502399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三才八卦本諸心。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995936141375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言三停八位，全在心思之巧而巳。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995936157759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好地只在方寸間，秘術不出文字外。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995936174143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方寸心也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995936190527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"占人云：欲求冨貴功名地，只在方員一寸間。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995936206911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此言吉地在吾心地，秘術在于秘書，惟得其人，斯得其地矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580352995936223295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947096515952694"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"土崩䧟而神魂不妥，來龍與朝山土石崩䧟，則龍神尅剥，其神魂不安矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014309430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木凋落而旺氣将衰。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014325814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"草木得氣之先，若墳宅之旁，草木惆落，則生氣不足，旺氣將衰，必主退敗。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014342198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"源泉混匕出明堂，氣随飄散；源泉之水，長流出扵明堂，是外氣不横，内氣随之而飄散。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014358582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白石磷匕張虎口，必主刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014374966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"磷匕","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014391350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek3203t/1-1709793639713.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=bsiF%2F3ND7etRPhfpi6eL65yRk0M%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek3203t/1-1709793639713.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580352996014587958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之事。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014587958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常聞水泣者，䘮禍頻見。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014604342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"時常聞水声哭泣者，可主有死䘮哭泣之事，應之。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014620726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其或聲響如環佩，進禄進財；其水跌桑，響如金環玉佩之声，主財禄兩進。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014637110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若然滴漏注銅壺，守州守郡。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014653494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若水响如銅壺滴漏之声不息，主出牧民之官。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014669878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鼕匕洞匕，響而亮者爲貴；水声如鼓，响而清亮者，爲竒地也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014686262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凄匕切匕，悲而泣者為災。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014702646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水流愴妻而悲泣者，主生灾。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014719030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948058824851497"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然而有聲不如無聲，此承上文言，大抵水流有声，不若澄凝無声也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014735414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明拱不如暗拱，局外秀峯暗拱，又勝局内之明拱也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014751798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一來一去，有福有灾；或一山一水来朝，又有一山水叛去，主有福，亦主有灾也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014768182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一急一緩，有利有害。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014784566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山水之緩者必有利，山水之急者必有害，仍審其得冝有情者為利也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014800950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"留心四顧，緩歩重登。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014817334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀地之法，必先尋龍，龍脉旣聚，然後入穴，穴法分明，然後觀左右前後砂水有情無情，及送護龍，顧與不顧，務要三回四顧，諼步留心，反復視之，方無悮也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014833718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十四山，山名太雜，羅經方位有二十四山，山之名有九星、五星，及人物、禽獸等名，為太雜三十六穴穴法何迁。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014850102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊筠松作立錐賦，有三十六穴訣，雖曰玄妙，有理可求，又何迁怪之有㢤？","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014866486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宗廟之水法悞人，范氏曰：宗廟之書，悮人為甚，以古人作之，以滅蛮國，謂之滅蛮，經，切不可用也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014882870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948154461798437"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五行之山運有凖。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014899254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅擇以五竹山運論，相生相尅，生則吉，死則凶，今人用之，","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014915638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek32cqx/1-1709793950533.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=r4OoIdEmipGF79o9UX0wIDzTADI%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek32cqx/1-1709793950533.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580352996014915638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福有準。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014915638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逆水來朝，不許内堂之池氣；山水逆耒，湏要到堂為吉，不許内堂傾□，反泄本身之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014932022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"翻身作穴，切湏外從之囬頭。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014948406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"畨作之勢，多無本身龍虎，湏要外生一枝，囬頭護托為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014964790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所貴關藏，所喜者，堂局紧密，水口関闌，穴内窩藏，使生氣之有聚也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014981174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最嫌空缺。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996014997558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所嫌者，堂局曠蕩，羅城空缺，穴内受風，則生氣之飄散也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015013942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隔水爲護者，何妨列似屏風；隔水有山来護，排列如屏風者，吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015030326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"就身生案者，湏要囬奸肘臂。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015046710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"本身龍虎為案，湏要弯環如肘臂者，以為吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015063094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母友不如已者，當求特","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015079478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" {"lines":[{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其祖宗山分来者，謂之同氣，及其行也如兄弟。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015112246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340947319543857215"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之同行，雌雄之並岀，及其止也，如君臣之慶會，賓主之相迎，只欲求之有情，何必拘十分厚壠也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015128630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尖山秀出，只消一峯二峯；前山尖秀聲時者，或一峯二峯皆吉，何拘扵多也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015145014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曲水来朝，不論人澗小澗若水湾回来朝有情，何拘扵大問小間。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015161398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衆水順流而散漫，不用劳神；衆水順流，而散不歸，决然無地，不用劳神。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015177782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四山壁立而粗雄，何勞着眼。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015194166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"回山","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015210550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek33215/1-1709794761697.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=WD85XNVMV%2FwRzBWPhF5t954zFtA%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek33215/1-1709794761697.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580352996015210550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"峻而粗大醜亚者，皆不結地，不足觀也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015210550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山無朝移夕改之勢，自開闢以耒，山净生成定矣，則無移","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015226934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" {"lines":[{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水有陵遷谷變之時。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015243318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水乃動物，故䏻惟東轉西，或淺或深，而有遷変之不常也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015259702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水不亂湾匕則氣全；水性直流，盖不苟湾匕抱之䖏，必主脉氣聚全以成言也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015276086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山不亂聚匕則形止。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015292470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山之聚䖏，則前迎後送，左抱右迴，而形以止之，夫豈苟聚之有㢤？","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015308854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948478366973989"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淺薄則出人淺薄，山水浅薄，則出人輕薄而不尊重，其福亦小也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015325238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寛平則出人寛干。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015341622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此承上文言地土淺薄，勢小，脉徴而無局，則出人輕薄而不重厚；若上厚水深而形局寛平，所謂一山一水有情者是巳，則出人亦寛洪大度而不側狭。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015358006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二者出人之相應，但加影響之相随。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015374390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"素書云：地廣者，大小不産，水淺者，大魚不逰。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015390774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其理一也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015407158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隻匕山尖射，豈予之所欲哉？","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015423542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山山尖射，人皆棄之。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015439926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"源匕水斜流，其餘不足觀也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015456310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水水斜流，不足觀也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015472694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後山不冝壁立，後山壁峻，謂之玄武，不埀頭，名曰扛屍，必主出，絕，不可忏之也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015489078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek33rbd/1-1709695892964.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=58rdI9epSimZYtF6l0BySA0RC7A%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek33rbd/1-1709695892964.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580352996015505462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水最怕直流，去水欲其湾曲，最怕直流無情，故陶公旦去水直流，則田牛退散。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015505462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更嫌来短去長，山水發源𠁅，来水若短，去水若長，必無大地，雖紫巧亦輕可而巳。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015521846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948373014315062"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"切忌左傾右瀉，左右水神傾海，是八字分流，至凶之兆，主家散人亾。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015538230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流神峻急，雖屈曲而驟𤼵驟衰，水不歌急，若急合流阧瀉，雖柘局發福，亦不乆逺也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015554614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水口闗闌不重叠而易成易敗。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015570998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水口有三五重関闌至八九重交牙関鎖者，主闕内必結大冨貴之地，發福必乆逺。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015587382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若一重関而不叠鎖者，成敗如反掌之易見矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015603766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墨或勢如浪湧，何湏卓立之峯；似言来龍雖無尖秀之峯，但圎净重叠，如巨浪之之湧，亦為竒也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015620150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：勢如巨浪，重嶺叠嶂，十乗之塟，其平洋田墟之浪，若水之波，义勝扵高龍也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015636534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脉若帶連，何必髙昻之阜。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015652918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍脉歌断不断，彰連而来者吉，何必髙昻之峯也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015669302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帶連者貴接續而不斷，此承上文續而不断，必如藕線絲亲，万為貴也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015685686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浪湧者湏重叠以爲竒。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015702070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"浪男而未層耒如滚多者為裔，故曰：龍要来了来，砂要堆了堆。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015718454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948478367006757"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脉有同𠏉異枝，枝𭒡延蔓；延蔓散亂也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015734838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正龍謂之榦匕，又生枝，俱要護纏為吉，最嫌散亂無情。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015751222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍經云：枝龍腰上可裁半是","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015767606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek343yh/1-1709697244079.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ROfuPj4o0aZgW5FOccjlh8RrdPQ%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek343yh/1-1709697244079.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580352996015767606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"花半是開。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015767606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是虚花無朝對，若是結實護纒回。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015783990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勢有囬龍顧祖，祖忌壓髙，囬龍顧祖之地，乃是祖山作朝，不宜太高大近，若髙而壓，近而迫者，不可扦之。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015800374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"撥砂云：逺朝不忌侵天，近朝不宜過頭。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015816758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舊本作祖不厭高，恐悮。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015833142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若髙近而壓穴，何以取之也？","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015849526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"察其老嫩精粗，老則嗟峩剛硬，嫩則委蛇柔軟；精則秀鹿圓爭，粗則蠢俗髙雄。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015865910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"審其生旺休廢。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015882294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山動曰生，葺起曰旺，隠伏曰休，死净曰廢。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015898678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水曲曰生，水聚曰旺，水澤曰休，水謝曰廢。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996015915062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"册□結上文山水形勢而言，生旺精嫩者吉，休廢粗老者凶，非方体之論。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186259497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右第十八章通論山水","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186275881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若言陽宅，何異隂宫。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186292265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽宅居","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186308649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek34gll/1-1709697464084.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=RLzyIPAPgsJrmIR2yQ6vFbcor9U%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek34gll/1-1709697464084.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580352996186308649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"也，隂宫墳慕也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186308649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽二宅，論山川之氣，散聚之理，則一司旦陽。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186325033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948373014347830"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宅尤喜寛平，隂宅只冝精巧。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186341417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊公云：問君陽宅要安居，此與安墳事一如。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186357801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人家無墳有吉宅，宅與隂地實無異。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186374185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最要地勢寛平，不冝堂局逼窄。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186390569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽宅最要地勢寛舒，且平正為上，逼窄則小居址也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186406953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若居山谷，最怕凹風；山谷之宅，最忌凹風，匕吹則氣散，左凹風則長房欠，右凹風則小房虧。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186423337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在平洋，先湏得水。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186439721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平洋之地，湏要水勢環闌，或當靣朝堂，則人財兩旺也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186456105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"圡有餘，當闢則闢，闢，開除也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186472489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂或尖利，有妨碍處，當除則除之可也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186488873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山不足，當培則培。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186505257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"培，増補也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186521641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂有不足𠁅，可以裁長補短，鋤髙益低，使適其中。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186538025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或問客王恐不相納，殊不知工力得法，","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186554409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek34t8p/1-1709697701081.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=K0Tz%2BfQLBE78SaNyC3LYTRkXzjI%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek34t8p/1-1709697701081.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580352996186554409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若生成父后，自然柏應。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186554409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"撥砂云：墻垣塹籬若生成，尚應吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186570793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今捕客土，遮風塞水，豈不相納之有㢤？","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186587177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先宅後墳，匕必興而宅必退；此言立宅在前，安墳在後，墳奪宅氣，故墳興而宅退。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186603561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948478367072293"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先墳後宅，匕旣盛而墳自衰。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186619945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與言安墳在前，立宅在後，宅截墳脉，故宅盛而墳衰也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186636329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墳宅之圖明堂平曠，萬象森羅；明堂平正而開廣，則萬象森列扵前，死主財源大旺之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186652713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衆水歸朝，諸山聚會，水如衆水之朝宗，砂似衆星之拱極，此必結大富貴之地。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186669097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"草茂术繁，水深土厚甘泉土肥，竹木叢茂，可見其氣之盛也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186685481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：墳前明净無遮蔽，宅後偏宜亡緑。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186701865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"樹濃遮蔽四時形不露，安居乆逺禄千鍾，隂陽宅並可追。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186718249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"築坝栽培竹木䕃庇則人財悠逺。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186734633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948373014380598"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墻垣籬塹，俱要回環，塹，溝坑也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186751017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"两邉山相顧有情，只輕可而門。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186964009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所戒者神前佛後，俗云：神前佛後，旺氣應注。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186980393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神靈","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186996777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek36kg9/1-1709706049454.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=2uUoz8rKIc%2FaRUcn%2BzubgXvYjZI%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek36kg9/1-1709706049454.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580352996186996777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂相觸，惟恐居之不安。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996186996777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若脉氣大旺，各有結作，又不可拘此而棄也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187013161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其神廟或在源頭而障風，或鎮地户而塞水，而斯為美矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187029545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948478367105061"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壇廟必居，水口神廟社壇宜居水口。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187045929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劉氏曰：有大橋林木，亦䏻發福。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187062313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"伐木毀廟，凶","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187078697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek36x3d/1-1709706149046.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=kKBrxxsjDcXXuOqBt6%2BEKPuMJLo%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek36x3d/1-1709706149046.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580352996187078697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之來，不可振也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187078697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羅星忌見當堂圓山土撴，謂之羅星，喜居水口，忌見當堂，逼近有害，隔逺無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187095081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上數事，宅墓一同。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187111465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形局小者不冝，傷殘寸土，惜如寸玉；山谷之穴，能脉細巧，而結局方分，不冝施功穿鑿，恐傷生氣，主人財不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187127849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故惜土如惜王者，貴之至，惜之甚也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187144233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"垣局濶者何妨充廣千家，任住千年平地之宅，乃髙壟降勢，落下平洋，龍氣旺盛，而結局必大，又淂龍之所㑹，水之所聚，垣局則寛舒，扦大州建縣，次則市鎮卿林千家，謂人烟輳集之多也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187160617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旺之𠁅，縱此小工，鑿而無禍，益陽氣沉潜。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187177001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187193385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一山一水有情，小人所止；山一水之情，此小結局而巳，非君子之居，雖好亦不長逺也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187209769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大勢太形入局，君子攸居。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187226153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此結上文局勢寛大之所，必有大富貴家居之而悠久也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187242537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948108672794687"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"泰山之麓水交流，孔林最茂；山足曰麓，交流水之交會也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187258921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東魯泰山，靈秀听鍾，其水交㑹，故孔聖人宅墓在爲。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187275305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫惟山川秀鹿，故䕃注綿延，而子姓蕃衍也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187291689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍虎山中風不動，仙圃長春。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187308073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍虎山，在江西廣信府貴溪縣。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187324457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其山川完宻，局不露風，超異乎衆，故張真人世居焉。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187340841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟其山川周宻，所以發福悠長，世襲其傳也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187357225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek37mdl/1-1709706640496.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2FgUUHTXgNdF%2F9C1eDEpfAUdhyWo%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek37mdl/1-1709706640496.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580352996187537449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九卷，發天地之秘奥，泄隂陽之玄微其術之精玅，幾近如神，未易窺測，學者在潜心熟慮以求之。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187537449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"法度固難盡述，機關湏自變通。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187553833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地理法度至多，難以盡述，在人随机而変通也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187570217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣造玄微，自忘寢食。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187586601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學者旣入精微之處，則悦樂有日進，自然夜忘寢而書忘食也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187602985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亟稱水何取扵水，誰㑹孔聖之心；此言水之有源可貴，誰意會孔聖之心乎？","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187619369","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盡信書不如無書，還要離婁之目。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187635753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不如無書。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187652137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅非真謂無書而可也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187668521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"書乃先賢之秘訣，地理之凖繩。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187684905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖書有真假，地理有繩剥，不可不辨。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187701289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖離婁，古之明目者，未聞䏻察地理乎。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187717673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"賦禀雖云天定，夫盛衰消長之変，一定而不可僣移者，雖聖智巧力無䏻爲，盖天命之所賦也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187734057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek37z0p/1-1709706838855.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=iUosdNFqd7O%2B21wc598cD0SmiYc%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek37z0p/1-1709706838855.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580352996187750441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福多自已求。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187750441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祸福無門，惟人自召。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187766825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善悪之報，如影随形，故君子可不慎乎？","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187783209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"智者樂水，仁者樂山，是之取爾，水動，故智者周流無滯而好水；山静，故仁者重厚不","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187799593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948373014429750"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好故。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187799593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秀氣所鍾之。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187815977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"處必成吉地，是以取之爾；天之生人，地之生穴，夫豈偶然。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187832361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天生一人，地生一穴，在随其所積而致居之耳。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187848745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以𠁅死則兆域，生則以营終，如吉人淂吉穴。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187865129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凶人得凶穴，夫豈偶然而致之㢤？","logicSentenceId":"7580352996187881513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲求滕公之佳城，漢夏侯嬰封滕公，駕至東都門，馬鳴不前，以足跑地久之。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656021558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公使人掘地三尺，淂石廓，銘曰：佳城欝匕，三千年見白日。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656037942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吁嗟滕，滕，公居此室。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656054326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"公曰：嗟乎！","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656070710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地，吾死塟扵山乎！","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656087094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"事皆前定，豈偶然㢤！","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656103478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"湏積叔敖之隂德，楚孫叔敖為㓜兒時，出逰，見兩頭蛇，殺而埋之。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656119862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"旣歸，憂而不食。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656136246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母問其故，曰：人言見両頭蛇者，必死也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656152630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兒今日見之。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656169014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母曰：蛇恐，今安曰：在乎？","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656185398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"他人又見之，巳埋之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656201782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"母曰：無憂，汝今不死矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656218166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吾聴卑，爾死興楚。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656234550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及長為楚相，享以夀考，流芳百世，宜哉！","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656250934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"積善必獲吉扦，吉地不易求，而良師尢難遇，淂而全之，誠隂徳之所致也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656267318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948298120937499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"積恶還招凶地。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656283702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吾郡東山趙先生作葬書問荅，有問曰：今之名卿大家，其先世塟地多驗，如執劵取物，至其盛時，竭力以求，輙無所得，或反倍謬取禍。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656300086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈有分定者不可推移耶？","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656316470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"對曰：不仭，如是而巳矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656332854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家之將興，必前世多潜徳隂養厚施而不食其報。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656349238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是者雖不擇而塟，其吉地之遇，與子孫之昌，固巳潜符黙契，盖天畀之也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656365622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後世見其先之鼎盛，而不知所自来，扵是妙貪巧取，牢籠刻削，以為不知何人之計，則其慿福恃勢以造悪之□，而獲罪扵天，自促其數者多矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656382006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"擇而無得，匕而倍謬，豈非天理之顯著者㢤？","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656398390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此二句原在十八","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656414774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" {"lines":[{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"切記寶而藏之非人勿示。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656693302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此卜先生之至嘱也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656709686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖是書上可以安邦定國，賛助皇圖，下可","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656726070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948154461863973"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以建縣扦州，輯安黎庶，其扵墳得宅，生者得以以安利居藏死者事有関扵送終之大節，庶幾有補扵世之萬一。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656726070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故當寳而藏之，不可傳，非其人以悮世也。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656742454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡吾同志者，其鍳之也，慎傳後之學者，永世無窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656758838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卜先生作此書，不私以秘已，惟公以傳人，然亦惟慎得扵授，其受誠人，而傳之則流。","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656775222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"布萬古豈有終窮乎？","logicSentenceId":"7580352996656791606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尋龍認山祖，金木水火土。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250265088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五星變九星。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250281472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生尅看山情，星辰看生旺起伏冝雄壯。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250297856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍行分八字，左右須囘顧。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250314240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上分下合来，要水隨魚腮。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250330624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"登山尋水口，入穴看明堂。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250347008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水口明堂聚，方可去消詳。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250363392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"来龍出身巧，両畔要生爪。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250379776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"護送三枝出，中心爲第一。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250396160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"點穴不拘多，看取胍如何。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250412544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂水皆朝聚，便可其中取。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250428928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髙山行龍䖏，起伏飛鵝勢。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250445312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平地去尋龍，草蛇灰線蹤。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250461696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或如獸犢行，護送要相迎。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250478080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"就水或泥墟，石脈渡江溪。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250494464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平洋髙一","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250510848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948154461929509"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寸，卽是脈起突。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250510848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髙要不當風，低要不失脉。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250527232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"急龍扦緩𠁅，湏要明堂聚。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250543616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"緩龍急𠁅托，明堂聚要圜。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250560000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍要来了来，穴要隈了隈。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250576384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂要堆了，堆，水要回了四。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250592768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脈要不離棺，棺要不離脉。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250609152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"棺脉兩相就，剥花如接木。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250625536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正龍要尋原，横龍要截腰。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250641920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"點穴明杖秋，葢粘併倚撞。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250658304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂水両宜好，葬後無煩惱。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250674688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山水走東西，葬後一場凶。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250691072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"葬破天罡頭，不死一場愁。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250707456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離穴復脫脉，下後子孫絶。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250723840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"社廟莫尋龍，葬後必然凶。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250740224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"欲知要出貴，四畔髙峰是。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250756608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前後迟三台，富貴自天来。","logicSentenceId":"7580385549250772992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前後有尖峰，定出状元公。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550083817524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四畔弯弓執，銀帶羅衣至。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550083833908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知得出富，左右看倉庫。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550083850292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四畔","logicSentenceId":"7580385550083866676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948298121035803"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"起貟峰，荣醇似石崇。","logicSentenceId":"7580385550083866676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍虎轉弯，","logicSentenceId":"7580385550083883060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" {"lines":[{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"筆山若然青，富貴自然興。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010796470307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"筆山赤黄地，把火進田地。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010796486691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"筆山若指塘，先進塘時後進粮。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010796503075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"筆山若指地，先進地時後進契。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010796519459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948686848966706"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"筆山若低小，夜裡進田畝。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010796535843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"筆山両腦長，断定五担粮。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010796552227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平地進神髙一丈，粮有一百上。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010796568611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平地進神五尺髙，五十富英豪。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010796584995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忽然微匕三尺起，一石五斗是，若生三尺一般强。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010796601379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十五担粮，七尺八尺與君知。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010796617763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七十二石最爲竒。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010796634147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進神山上稜層峰，爲官冨貴出英雄。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010796650531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進神之山連倉庫，進粮又進榖。","lo ":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山背有山若出頭，䕃人做賊便。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010796945443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偷牛前面一山伸脚去，人㑹偷盗物。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010796961827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午邜酉比，方山，穵壁又穿籬。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010796978211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若然漏脚似拖鎗，打刼入官方。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010796994595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㢘貞尖利一般同，破碎茅葉叢，更說人家有，雀巢口舌官事多。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797010979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或然腫脚出坎然，黄腫皆因此處生。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797027363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"門前水直似車槽，婦女傷夫不","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797043747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948686849065010"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用刀。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797043747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靣前一山似死屍，外死及扛屍，或似鉢盂似，跪爐，僧道好規模。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797060131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面前崩破并赤黄，更生痨瘵吐紅郎。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797076515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入門㸔左右，兩邉怕生病。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797092899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左邉神煞凶，長子命先終。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797109283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右邉神殺多，小子命南柯。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797125667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前靣神杀惡，中子先殺却。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797142051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍虎共條路，男子皆吊死。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797158435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎有䟦三両條，隂人三個懸梁吊。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797174819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青龍如此様，男子吊髙梁。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797191203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明堂行破牛馬𣦸，女子崩紅見血光。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797207587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水星湧浪前面當，人家飬女自招郎。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797223971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逺山窠見一千坑，室女伴人眠献花。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797240355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面前若見兩脚開，女人求食覔将来。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797256739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此是神仙真口訣，千金不與度凢材。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797273123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進田筆山何處是？","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797305891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分明要在明堂裏。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797322275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不拘左右面前生，只要看他如何指。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797338659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逆水尖来向面前，招進南庒北保田，弯轉抱身牛角様，進入錢財家大旺。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797355043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若然順水不堪言，退盡資財賣盡田。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797371427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"筆直低頭随水走，家財田地俱乏了。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797387811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尖匕直去硬如鎗，不出軍兮出少亾。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797404195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"筆頭若然人踏破，踏破財山便生𥚟，踏着財頭財便發，剪着財腰動瘟瘧○進田筆逆水出，退田筆，順水出断頭筆。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797420579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耳背出吏官筆，案上出學士筆，雲霽出状元筆，纎匕出秀才筆；架上出𥁞師筆，長短亂雜","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797436963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948758210904074"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出天師筆。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797436963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤艮巽出筆頭。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797453347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若帶石，常與人交易。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797469731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴前若見筆頭開，十遭赴舉九空囬，名曰罵天筆。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797486115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上山湏要識，口訣不湏多。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797502499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尋龍先尋最大峯，却𣷸枝脉看行蹤。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797535267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"真龍盡處最堪為，仔細觀瞻吉與凶。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797551651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"茫上平地尋龍逺，上来山裏認脉蹤。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797568035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㦯有周囬山水抱，自然聚氣更藏風。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797584419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衆山齊大小為尊，衆山齊小大山墳。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797600803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衆低髙者還為貴，衆髙低者最超群。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797617187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三山齊為正龍，只就中間擇正宗。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797633571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要識兩邉皆侍從，自然有穴不湏","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797649955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948686849097778"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797649955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衆山齊短一山長，長者爲龍最吉昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797666339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"長山未塟短山發，正龍一葬傍山滅，左畔来龍右畔扞，急脉来龍緩𠁅安，緩脈急𠁅穴天然。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797682723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"安墳龍脉合真經，好合天然山坦平，爲報吉星留尅應，五龍生旺位中尋。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797699107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡入明堂湏周機，好如媍女抱兒孫，萬般只愛媍懐抱。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797715491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水惡山凶水只宜。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797731875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明堂廣闊星峰秀，水勢湾環點穴宜。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797748259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不問五音皆下得，自然發福任施為。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797764643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大地坦平不見山，就中忏穴認弯環。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797781027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或然大地坦匕平，欲識踪跡仔細明。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797797411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"節匕莫離坵壠是，草蛇灰線識真情。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797813795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"茫茫萬里平如掌。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797830179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二十四山都没向，就中相水便安墳。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797846563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797862947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948686849130546"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉朝来家大旺，獨山無從號孤单，只作僧堂及社壇。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797862947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仍是後龍多頓伏，此山莫作等閑㸔。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797879331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍胍低平突一峰，無朝無從號孤龍，此山只好為僧道，或作神壇一仙蹤。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797895715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劈脈分枝是鬼龍，直如鵞頚屈如弓。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797912099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小名為鬼大為殺，只宜神廟有靈通。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797928483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴髙終是殺傷龍，少見荣華多見凶。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010797944867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俗子不能為審辨，至今多見逺山峯。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884403252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君莫貪髙想望逺，山上如逰不囬還。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884419636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"豈知脚下明堂小，賣盡田園屈指間。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884436020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第四要識水金城，湾匕囬抱似眠弓。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884550708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
