{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此是楊公真口訣，莫向人前輕漏泄。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884665396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其中却有十三怕，最向明師與君話。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884681780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一怕空亾，二怕壓，三怕脚飛，四怕挿，五怕泄氣，六水牽，七怕明堂水不合，八怕凹風，九怕逼，十怕面前鎗頭直，十一孤单十二麄，十三更","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884698164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948758210936842"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"怕氣脉短。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884698164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"請君要識十三怕，此是楊公秘宻話。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884714548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":8,"content":"尋龍下篇","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884730932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"登山尋龍，湏認祖宗，龍脉降勢，起伏過峡，變換生尅，金貟木直，土乃平匕，水尖水曲，正是五星。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884747316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穿田度水，有石陽蹤，就水臨泥，有脉微士。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884763700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平髙一寸，便是根基。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884780084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羅星塞水，更要離水，水口関闌。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884796468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其中可取，龍穴真机，要識高低。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884812852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山厚人肥，山瘦人肌，山清人貴，山暗人迷，山囬人聚，山走人離，山確人勇，山縮人弱，山順人孝，山逆人潑。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884829236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"脉真易下，氣真易識。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884845620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髙不露風，低不脱脉，龍穴分明，何劳心力。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884862004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"似有似無，藏蹤","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884878388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948576526155814"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"閃跡。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884878388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"草蛇灰線，仔細識認。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884894772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仰掌平坡，鋪氊展席。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884911156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此等形模，使人不識，切認交襟。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884927540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明堂湏聚，點穴穿珠，如人針刺，脉不離棺，匕不離脉，棺脉相就，剥花接木，脫胍離穴，壊爛骨殖，傷龍敗脉，䖝蟻自入。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884943924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"細認来龍，毫厘絲忽。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884960308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍從左来，穴居右裁；龍從右来，穴居左裁。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884976692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上分下合，要㸔護托，正脉取斜。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010884993076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斜脉取正，直脉取曲，匕脉取直，閗脉取饒匕脉取閗，雙脉取单，匕脉取雙。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885009460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無䖏取有，断䖏取續，硬胍取軟，散脉取聚。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885025844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大處取小，匕𠁅取大，長䖏取短，匕處取長。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885042228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"石山取土，土山取石。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885058612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"剛用其柔，匕用其剛，雄変爲雌，匕変爲雄。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885074996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三山齊出，","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885091380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948576526188582"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縮者為尊。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885091380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"正脉取頭，横脉葬腰捨生閃死抄搭取勾，形傾左右，穴居両邉。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885107764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"挨左捨右，㸔其應樂。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885124148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髙大爲雄，低小為雌。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885140532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俯者爲隂，仰者爲陽，動者為生，静者為死。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885156916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"急脉取緩，匕脉取急。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885173300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髙山取窟，平地取突，正脉関口，或取毬簷，左勾右搭，金魚要合龍虎強弱順逆，要取旺䖏，塟其所聚。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885189684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八風要藏，八将要朝，四水要歸，四神要拱，三合要取，三陽要全。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885206068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鉗唇鍋腦，其穴莫討。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885222452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鎗頭覆鍾，切忌八風。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885238836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"狗薮蛇屯，葬後動瘟，破衣百結，葬後便絶。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885255220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鋸床筲箕，穴恐水直，頑鉄犂壁，其穴無下。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885271604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"混無窩突，其穴莫作。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885287988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍穴，砂水四畔為主。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885304372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"真龍正脉，","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885320756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948686849196082"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂水皆聚。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885320756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有龍無穴，官司敗滅；有穴無龍，家無老翁。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885337140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神廟鬼龍，葬後必凶；水中無穴，葬後必絕。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885353524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"髙看腌臍，低看合襟。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885369908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要明倒杖，盖粘倚撞。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885386292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肥瘦尖員，摽凖深淺。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885402676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天地人穴，上中下截，大小八字。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885419060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天乙太乙，點穴真机。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885435444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手中為則，大母指根，點塩指節。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885451828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左右仙宫，虎口可民。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885468212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上分下聚，毬簷介字，三人齊口。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885484596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禾鍬口生水要抱五蝦鬚𧒻眼，金魚界合，明堂護托，内藏金斗，外掩人口。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885500980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴要藏煞，塟後便發。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885517364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"悞指山崗，立見凶殃。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885533748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍穴端正，富貴自定。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885550132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左右直長，退敗恓惶。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885566516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前後山峯，官至三公。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885582900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"横屍露骨，多生宿疾。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885599284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明堂掌心，積玉堆金。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885615668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明堂。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885632052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948758210969610"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傾瀉退敗凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885648436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四畔山飛，父子東西，水不之玄，退敗牛田。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885664820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前後湾弓，富貴無窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885681204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左右斜沍，千萬莫看。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885697588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水怕直流，牽動水牛，淋頭割脚，瘟㾮退落；田堘水圳，横者爲進，直来冲心，灾𥚟難當。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885713972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"砂水斜流，何足為竒。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885730356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不㑹消砂，凶𥚽如麻；不㑹納水，災殃便起。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885746740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"認看不真，悞殺多人。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885763124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不明此說，両眼如盲。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885779508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍穴砂水，四畔要羙，淂此口功，知吉知凶，若精此作，天下横行。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885795892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"真龍不度，𢙣水好砂，自無返情。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885828660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍穴分明，砂水自顧。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885845044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形大","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885861428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948758211002378"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者宜遷陽宅，勢小者則利隂居。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885861428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俟生閃死，盖粘倚撞，轉觜轉勾，或牽或扯，相生相吉，相尅相凶。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885877812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金喜土生，木愛水飬，土喜火生，仍用木發，水愛金生，得以俱全。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885894196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽髙聳，太隂正斜，冲天羅睺，排山叠障。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885910580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek5n289/1-1710333021588.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Kef%2BjLKc0H0z9UFauBqCiBEM%2BSs%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek5n289/1-1710333021588.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580387010885943348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek5nevd/1-1710333036372.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=VoUiJpVf1wCFpN2X%2FoKMJ1swJOs%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek5nevd/1-1710333036372.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580387010885943348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"難遇難求，逄之将相，斬砍自由，己皆爲穴中之貴格，爲世上之難求。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885943348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"前面若有返砂，爲官不乆，爲富不長。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885959732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論其水有交腮来者，為之蟹眼蝦鬚；有湾抱者，爲之金魚。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885976116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直去直来，木星最𢙣，斜側尖瀉，火速無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010885992500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"屈曲之玄，水星","logicSentenceId":"7580387010886008884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948686849228850"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"湧㑹，山秀人丅，興旺主貴水吉，財谷豐盈。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010886008884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仍依諸卦五行消納，方無力生𥚽福。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010886025268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴凶龍吉，先貧後富居官；穴吉龍凶，先富後貧，破敗本身，手脚重匕抱印誥相隨，百世榮。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010990899234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍来無送無朝，定是孤絕之地。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010990915618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天罡金水，冨貴英豪；破禄文𤎉，死亡獄訟。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010990932002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山朝水聚，財寳如山。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010990948386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"水走山飛，財散人離。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010990964770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金頭火脚，神炫必作左山。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010990981154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"手脚多者，長房多子多孫。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010990997538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左右叠匕一般，定断房匕俱好。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991013922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左生右死小敗，右生左死長衰。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991030306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三台品字，定俱一品之尊；瘦削低平，豪富，二紀而衰，金喜居西。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991046690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南方是火木愛居東，水星北地得此者，冨貴永綿。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991063074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墳宅吉","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991079458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340949113027969051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"者，無不吉利。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991079458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論此五星之法，世人觧之鮮矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991095842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見馬山便出馬。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991128610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"嘶噉人驚怕，馬口開時馬咬人。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991144994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顛馬是如真。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991161378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"靣前大馬趕小馬，富貴傳天下。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991177762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬𦮯馬後貴人生，代代有聲名。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991194146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東方定出青騘馬，甲乙木馬也。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991210530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南方赤馬要君知。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991226914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"神馬最爲竒。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991243298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"北方黒馬西方白，定出真端。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991259682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"睡蚕馬出申，𢈏方歲匕旺蚕桑。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991276066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卿官馬出如何取？","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991292450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人在後護低木。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991308834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人在馬前，屍馬出孤寒。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991325218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤艮巽天師馬。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991341602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"香火傳天下，腰長定断平爐山僧道此中看印山落在何方取，好向墳前","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991357986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948576526221350"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顧。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991357986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或在龍頭或帯珠，子細認規模。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991374370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或在平洋或在水，員石一同是。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991390754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是禾峰印又長，員印作官郎。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991407138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙壬庚甲寳，正印天師乾坤良。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991423522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"石頭磊匕水中多，養鴨大如鵝。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991439906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴格龍神出此𠁅，子細墳前認石頭。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991456290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"磊又過江来，接盡世間財。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991472674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"望見逰魚隨便断，更有明珠案。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991489058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大魚在後小魚前，代匕出官貟。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991505442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大魚若在小魚後，為官不長乆。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991521826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上水逰魚頭帶珠，官軄近皇都。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991538210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上水逰魚極是好，爲多財寳。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991554594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下水逰魚頭向墳，孝義旺兒孫。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991570978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東方逰魚甲乙上，紫衣出和尚。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991587362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南方逰魚一代官，灰袋是山足。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991603746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"西方逰魚極是好，賜紫金魚到。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991620130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"北方。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991636514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逰魚打綱","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991652898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340949113028001819"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人，常被水淋身。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991652898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一個逰魚出千户，両個朝中住。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991669282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三個四個結成群，朝賀聖人君。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991685666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墳前若有尖峰起，定出為官貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991702050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是禾峰當面迎，巨富有聲名。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991718434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第一墳前要財禄，左右来拱伏。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991734818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見面前似拜龍，富貴求昌隆。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991751202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拜龍之山坐水口，三五相連有。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991767586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"恰似推車進寳来，進貢外州財。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991783970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尋絲之山如蛇様，醮水墳前向，莫令出去似生蛇，離寳别人家。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991800354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"踏節之山如踏節。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991816738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"磊七行街歇，形如小兒舞袖形，衙杖手中呈展旗。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991833122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"牙刀出武聀，定出為官。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991849506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉安床角鼓面前生，定出武官人。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991865890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見邪峯坐水口，恰似人醉酒。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991882274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三五相連似覆鍾，家冨結錢隆。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991898658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948576526254118"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"坐立墳前似乂手，恰似人舞袖。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991915042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拜舞時師獻寳来，進貢外州財。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991931426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青龍似拳頭，家裡閙啾匕。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991947810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"高大分明好，富貴永無休。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991964194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青龍似銖鑚，買田論千貫。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991980578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論州罵縣人，鎮押郷村清。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010991996962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青龍山直去，子息離鄉住。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992013346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外有山來褁，外保置田土。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992029730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青龍褁白虎，家裡財無数。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992046114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孝順好兒孫，能文又能武。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992062498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青龍頓起好尖峯，兒孫代又出英雄。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992078882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鄕里人驚怕，富貴有官封。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992095266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青龍如勒馬，富貴傳天下。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992111650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外有好山峯，打馬糶禾公。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992128034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青龍開口咲吟吟，三年常進十餘丁。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992144418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一要上山先看左，且要砂来褁。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992160802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有左砂救淂人，世代永無貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992177186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更要上山看地勢，且要星辰起。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992193570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948758211035146"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四畔羅城似覆鍾，家富結錢隆。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992209954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是山上不仔細，水返人家退羅城。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992226338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"纒繞水朝墳，家冨永無貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992242722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎轉頭来，常進外人財。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992259106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎似鶴爪，出得女人巧。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992275490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"八十婆匕夜不眠，做布買人田。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992291874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎橫来抱，一似初月到團圎。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992308258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如笋山頭上，官職坐朝堂。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992324642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎山上起圎峯，定出老婆罵老公。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992341026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其人說話只由妻，喝淂似烏龟。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992357410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎山嵯峨，其家出寡婆。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992373794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"滛亂家中有，瘟火見生戈。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992390178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左右山砂似蒜頭，槌門夜晚送大坵。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992406562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青龍重叠𧺫尖峯，兒孫世伐結錢隆。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992422946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎軟如綿，孝順四方傳。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992439330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山峰重叠𧺫，子息足牛田。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992455714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好地恰如牛見犬，山砂隻匕回頭轉。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992472098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948576526286886"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好地恰如公抱孫，常在懷禆煖敦匕。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992488482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面前一山如脫襪，鬼運錢禾發。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992504866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面前一山似伏後，鬼運錢禾人不知。","logicSentenceId":"7580387010992521250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面前開脚向墳頭，婦人留客逞風流。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102507023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其家定是多滛慾，世上人傳不怕羞。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102523407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大娥媚下小娥媚，小娘與郎共羅幃。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102539791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"娥媚金星兩脚長，室女貪花愛好郎。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102556175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左畔起旗右畔鼓，爲官定武。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102572559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文武兼全塞上功武略定英雄。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102588943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"懐筆之山生脚下，出在明堂也，左右辨錢及價錢，懐筆買人田。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102605327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"横財之山如爪瓠，抱入財無数，形如牛角轉弯匕。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102621711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"便是進財山。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102638095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一筆進田同上契，二筆進田地，八庄，三筆四筆相連有兄弟。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102654479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"啇量置外庄。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102670863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"筆山且","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102687247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340948576526319654"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要看長短，莫将一倒㸔。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102687247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若然長者是刀山，短者是筆山。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102703631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相公筆雲霄出秀才筆案背出曹師筆，案頭出畫匠。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102720015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"筆成把出退田筆，随水出。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102736399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"筆山頭有園，買得田来定相連。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102752783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"筆山上有路，行篙點火送契來。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102769167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"筆山上有崩，買得田来賣與人。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102785551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"筆山如松樹，論官休罷我。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102801935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"面前若有連珠庫，家裡財無数日夜。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102818319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"進田進財，倉庫自然開。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102834703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山似人眠出長病，山如人武出顛邪。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102851087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"山山開脚人無禮，山如厨庫有錢生。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102867471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青龍白虎出花叢，名爲花酒少年中。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102883855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大小女人貪好色，定是沿墻睹裏通。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102900239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"青龍磊匕在墳前，其家買得好良田。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102916623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外有山峯隨水邉，先","logicSentenceId":"7580387011102933007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"co 1,"content":"兒孫金榜上，題名","logicSentenceId":"7580387011421863951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340949113028034587"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"赴舉入朝廷。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011421863951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀之山頓起旗，鞍馬四邉至，顕世兒孫㑹文武，鎮國上将軍。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011421880335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀之山如馬楪，做客財山旺案前三峰至五峰，便是學生童。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011421896719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀之山覆箱楪，男女能書筭。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011421913103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又為財庫一般詳，觧典滿村鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011421929487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀之山，芭蕉櫟，碗斗随門唱更見両山似鼓槌，求食少衣衫。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011421945871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀之山雙峰起，男女雙生是。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011421962255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"端然尖秀入雲霄，双峰出官僚。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011421978639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武髙時低朱雀枉𣦸被人縛。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011421995023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"穴低男女命無長，不死著離鄕。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422011407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武三台華盖起，主客侵雲低。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422027791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"富貴家豪勝石崇，官位至三公。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422044175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武三峰侵雲漢，宋雀低漸断，若然水口不分開，男女去無回。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422060559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422076943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340949080798953481"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武三峯齊起主，跌落平洋住左右，亂峰生知府坐州城。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422076943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武之山起十峰，十代富無窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422093327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文星武曲送龍行，子息有聲名。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422109711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀不怕行來逺，如印如瓶盞落在平洋山漸髙家裡出英豪。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422126095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"䪺屏之山靜瓶様，家富人丁旺。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422142479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人寄金銀不取回，金玉滿聴臺。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422158863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"銀帯之山形似𠔃，弯又低小抱身躬。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422175247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"数峰相串如銀帯，子息為官坐帝京。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422191631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舉筆之山挿一峰，如鎗如笋","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422208015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek5nrih/1-1711268046266.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=5%2FvDz9RkDd2Csuv6kSJZx3P7X8k%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0175/2/ref/1kcc6pek5nrih/1-1711268046266.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7580387011422208015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雲中若見雲梯當面揖，兒孫代又出英雄。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422208015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左邉𧺫旗右鼓朝，斬斫為官出武僚。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422224399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天馬貴人當面楫，為官入幕帝王紹。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422240783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見五峰似蓮殻，宰相吃天禄。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422257167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"五峰齊聳入雲中，拜相","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422273551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340949214521737267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作三公。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422273551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逰魚之山形若魚，頭向墳前近水居。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422289935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下後定生賢貴子，名標金榜拜皇都。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422306319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"龍山無勢両邉斜，穴對紅旗實可誇。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422322703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必主殺傷并自縊，不然徒配定無差。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422339087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"學堂裏水响潺又，不出官時官自然。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422355471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"躍跳龍門金榜至，詩書不讀也爲官。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422371855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十道弯環在面朝，兒孫家積富多招。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422388239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兒孫秀鹿文章客，何用為官去入朝。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422404623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入穴湏教左右首，定分長小有貧寒。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422421007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東西日月無交雜，積谷三男一様看。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422437391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大山高𧺫壓墳前，出入落水井中眠。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422453775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更被城門并刹脚，誣刺官司多𥚽患。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422470159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"内城流出外城欄，此地名為進寳山。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422486543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"家有賢妻人富貴，無兒抱飬是真","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422502927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7340949113028067355"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"言。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422502927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第一水城向左邉，其家發積有牛田。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422519311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"因親運得資財冨，財物因親富自然。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422535695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是田中水口印，富貴天然定断此。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422552079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分明出大官，名題在長安。","logicSentenceId":"7580387011422568463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
